notes.title: Ver. 3.28 Update Note
notes.content:
[img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max"]

 

Hello, this is the Vindictus team.

Below are the list of changes available after the version update on September 23rd, 2025.

 

Table of Contents
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
1. Character Utility Improvements

Fiona - Common

Fiona - Longsword

Vella

[hr][/hr]
1. Character Utility Improvements

Fiona - Common

Improved the appearance of the character's face.

You can read more about these improvements in the Developer's Notes. \[Go to Developer's Notes]

 

Due to the makeup improvements, you will no longer be able to use the makeup you had previously equipped.

You will be able to craft a "Fiona Makeup Coupon" via Quick Crafting by right-clicking on the item.

The eyebrow improvements may slightly change the type and shape of your existing eyebrows.

Players who wish to change them will be able to earn a "Premium Appearance Alteration Coupon" in the upcoming event.

With the addition of the new hair, mole, and scar, players who had Fiona before the appearance improvement update will receive a "Fiona Appearance Revamp Celebration Reward" in the mail.

The contents of the reward are as follows.

Added the new status effect "Retribution" to the "Active: Taunt" skill.

While the status effect "Retribution" is active, you gain 1 stage for each successful "Shield Deflection."

The status effect "Retribution" increases your final damage by 3% per stage, up to a maximum of 5 stages (final damage increased by 15%).

The status effect "Retribution" lasts for the duration of the "Taunt" effect, and disappears when the status effect "Taunt" ends.

Added an effect where hitting an enemy with "Stigma Hammer" while equipped with a Large Shield will increase the duration of the status effect "Taunt" by 5 seconds.

The duration can be increased up to four times (for a total increase of 20 seconds).

Changed the "Active: Taunt" skill usage condition from "Available in normal raids" to "Available in all battles."

 

Hitting an enemy with "Active: Taunt" triggers the status effect "Taunt" and instantly grants you 1 stage of the status effect "Retribution."

Added remaining duration to the status effect "Retribution" UI.

While the status effect "Taunt" is active, hitting an enemy with Stigma Hammer while equipped with a Large Shield restores 100 SP.

Hitting an enemy with "Stigma Hammer" while equipped with a Large Shield will increase the duration of the status effect "Taunt" and the status effect "Retribution" by 5 seconds each.

The duration of the status effect "Retribution" can also be increased up to four times (for a total increase of 20 seconds).

Adjusted the tooltip description for the "Active: Taunt" skill to match the changes above.

Added new attack skill "Active: Taunt Strike."

This skill is a leap into the air followed by a slam into the ground, hitting enemies and attracting their attention for a short time.

"Active: Taunt Strike" also grants the "Taunt" effect when used, but the duration does not change with skill rank and is fixed at 5 seconds.

In this state, you cannot gain the "Retribution" status effect from a successful "Shield Deflection."

While the "Taunt" status effect gained from using the 'Active: Taunt' skill is active, using "Active: Taunt Strike" does not remove or renew the existing "Taunt" effect.

Changed the Smash enhancement effect that is applied on a successful "Active: Shield Deflection" to not apply to "Active: Shield Bash."

Changed "Active: Shield Deflection" so that even if you fail to deflect, you can still chain into a normal attack, smash attack, or active skill after 60 frames.

Adjusted "Active: Shield Enhancement" and "Active: Tireless" SP consumption from 250 to 100 SP.

Changed "Heavy Stander Counter" so that it can chain after the third hit of a normal attack after a successful attack.

"Shield Mastery Rank 9" and "Large Shield Mastery" can now be learned without completing the Story "Skill Challenge: Shield Mastery."

Fixed "Active: Iron Defense" so that it no longer consumes SP when used.

Changed the skill so that it cannot have "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" applied, as the skill's SP consumption has been removed.

If the skill currently has the "Efficient SP" Waking Stone applied, the applied Waking Stone will be changed to Efficient SP (30) and the "awakening failure" state.

It will be changed to an "awakening failure" state to prevent the skill's max awakening info from being removed if the skill's Waking Stone info is also removed.

Also changed the lowest rank's Efficient SP (30) so that there is no limit for applicable ranks if you switch to a different Skill Awakening Stone in the future.

Using "Honeybee Sting" and "Rose Thorns" after charging will continue to apply the "Shield Deflection" status effect as before.

Modified the "Active: Shield Charge" skill to have critical applied.

 

Revised tooltip descriptions so that skills can align with the character utility improvements.

 

Fiona - Longsword

Modified the additional attack frame length for "Amaranth Kick" from 160 frames to 100 frames.

Modified the additional attack of "Amaranth Kick" so that the start of the attack hitbox is now at 23 frames instead of 29 frames.

Modified the additional attack of "Amaranth Kick" to consume 6 STA instead of 17 STA at max rank.

Changed the "50 SP recovery effect" to "50 STA recovery effect" when "Amaranth Kick" additional attack hits.

Modified the point at which an "Amaranth Kick" additional attack can be chained to a guard action from "after 54 frames" to "after 40 frames."

Modified the point at which an "Amaranth Kick" additional attack can be chained to "Active: Shield Dash," activated by using the kick button, from "after 55 frames" to "after 41 frames."

Increased the damage of "Ivy Sweep" by 7%.

"Ivy Sweep" recovers 25 SP and 25 STA on successful hits.

 

Increased the damage of counterattacks used after "Active: Shield Enhancement" by 6%.

Increased the damage of "Active: Focal Point" by 5%.

 

Vella

Modified the duration of Cross Stance from "72 frames" to "42 frames" at max rank.

4. Mileage System

Added the Mileage Shop.

For more information, including mileage accumulation criteria and exchangeable products, please check the following event page. \[Go to Event Page]

 

Added a component to the "Supply Depot" UI where you can check how much Mileage you have.

Added the "Mileage Accumulation Icon" to products that are available for sale in the "Supply Depot" and "Wardrobe" that are eligible for Mileage accumulation.

Added Mileage accumulation information to the bottom of the "Supply Depot" and "Wardrobe" purchase/payment windows.

Added Mileage accumulation information to various UIs where products able to accumulate Mileage can be purchased.

 

NX prices for items available from the supply depot will be changed.

Items with prices that cause decimal points when transfered to Mileage(under tens digit) will be rounded down.

Temporal items available for purchase from the wardrobe are not subject to this change, and Mileage accumulation of these items will still be rounded down.

 
[hr][/hr]
5. Other Changes

Expertise

Added a text input method to the "Confirm Crafting" pop-up that appears when using enchanted equipment as a crafting material without using an Extraction Rune to prevent mistakes.

Added the same text input method for both crafting and crafting requests.

 

Items

Modified the "Comrade Destiny Box" item tooltip as shown below.

(Previous) An airtight box full of happy helpers. Right-click to claim one of the comrades below.

(Changed) A box full of happy helpers. Right-click to claim one of the comrades below.

Removed \[NX Reward] from the names of the "Outfit Destiny Box" and "Wings" items earned from previous NX Reward Events and replaced them with \[Mileage].

 

Battle

Fixed an issue where "Lucian's" name is incorrectly displayed when the "Alt" key is pressed during the cutscene at the start of the "Unjust Cathedral" battle.

Fixed an issue where the wings on "Macha's" back appear abnormally in the cutscene that plays at the start of the "Red Stigma" battle.

Fixed an issue where "Comrade: Jordra" would intermittently disappear during combat.

Fixed an issue that caused the status effect UI to be intermittently blank during combat.

 

During the Royal Army Battle "Frosted Omen," the following attacks used by "Ancient Stribog" will now have 50% less movement distance and slightly longer cooldowns than before.

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it jumps backwards, lands, and attacks

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it lunges forward and attacks once

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it lunges forward and attacks twice consecutively

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it attacks with an upward thrust, followed by a downward thrust

 

During the Royal Army Battle "Frosted Omen," the following attacks used by "Ancient Stribog" will now have cooldowns twice as long as before.

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it roars and deals damage to the area around it

"Ancient Stribog" pattern where it breathes out in front of it and attacks

 

Redeemers

Changed the condition to earn \[Full Force] from the battles "Sea of Reflection," "Dark Side of the Moon," "Tempering the Sword" and "Tree of Life" from completing the battles 30 times to 5 times.

If a character has completed 5 or more battles previously, then they can immediately use Full Force.

Changing the number of battles that need to be completed to earn Redeemers Seals and Mission Seals from 30 to 5.

Redeemers-related changes will be added to the play guide's "Guide Missions" descriptions and Help descriptions.

 

Story

Fixed an issue where the "Artisan's Stone" could not be obtained in the "Unjust Cathedral" battle during the "High Expertise Artisan" story.

Fixed an issue where some characters using "Jumping Potion" were unable to obtain the "High Expertise Artisan" story.

 
[hr][/hr]
4. Misc.

Fixed an issue where the graphics on the cape part appeared broken when a character was moving while wearing the "Special Nordic Prime Set."

Fixed an issue where the graphics appeared broken when Lynn's "Pointy Twin Tails" and the "Noblesse Helm" were equipped together.

Fixed an issue where the graphics on the arms appeared broken when striking certain poses after equipping the "Special Mystic Mage Set."

Fixed an issue where the graphics on the boots appeared broken when the "Special Nordic Prime Greaves" and "Special Nordic Prime Boots" were equipped together on certain characters.

Fixed an issue where the head part appeared hollow when equipping the "Special Nordic Prime Helm" on certain characters.

Fixed an issue with Grimden's "Bandage Inner Armor" outfit icon displayed the wrong colors.

Fixed an issue with Grimden's "Bandage Inner Armor" outfit tooltip not displaying RGB information.

Fixed an issue where Achel's "Beach Party Inner Armor" outfit had a different color than other male characters.

Fixed an issue where mouse scrolling did not work on the character selection screen when "Options → Video → Advanced → UI Size" was set to 120%.

Fixed an issue where dyeing Fusion Eriu Auxiliary Equipment would not reflect the color correctly.

Fixed an issue where Evie's head being adjusted to be slightly smaller caused her to look awkward in certain situations.

Fixed an issue where when "Arisha" smiles, the shape of her mouth looked awkward.

Fixed an issue where the ends of "Tessa's" hair looked awkward when equipping the "Cygne Rouge" hair.

Fixed an issue where toggling "Hide Other Players' Mini-Windows" in "Options → Video → Advanced → Hide Mini" would reset the setting in certain situations.

 
[hr][/hr]
We will always strive to do our best and provide you with the best Vindictus experience that we can.

Thank you!

12. Expertise

Added recipes for the Lv. 125 equipment Eriu Weapon and Head Armor.

You can craft Eriu Weapons through Weaponsmithing and Goldsmithing, based on the weapon type.

You can craft Eriu Head Armor through Armorsmithing and Tailoring.

The Lv. 125 auxiliary equipment Eriu Shield and Grand Targe can be crafted through Armorsmithing.

You can craft an Eriu Totem and Focus through Goldsmithing.

Every recipe can be obtained (based on probabilities) after clearing the new raid "Unjust Cathedral" while using a Core Boost.

You can also purchase the recipe you want by paying Lucian's Essence x3 (Weapons and Armor) or Lucian's Essence x2 (Auxiliary Equipment) at the Warm Welcome Shop.

Lucian's Essence can be obtained (based on probabilities) through "Weekly Raid Rewards," or by clearing "Unjust Cathedral" while using a Core Boost.

When crafting Eriu Weapon and Head Armor, the Legendary Uaithne Weapon and Legendary Uaithne Helm will be used as materials, and their Tuning statuses do not matter.

The Tuning stats on the Uaithne equipment used as material will be moved over to Eriu equipment.

Other than required materials, Extraction Runes can be used as selected materials when crafting Eriu Weapon and Head Armor.

When crafting using Extraction Runes as selected materials, the enchants from the Uaithne equipment used as materials can be transferred directly to the crafted Eriu equipment.

Whether the Extraction Runes used as selected materials are bound to your character does not affect whether the crafted Eriu equipment will be binding.

Added the 1/2 Weapon Transformation function.

This feature can be accessed by clicking Menu (Shortcut Key: T) > Equipment Share and Transfer > Equipment Transfer & Weapon Transformation. Select your current character as the target character to activate the UI and select the weapon you'd like to transform.

You can select and transform your current weapon into a different type. (Example: Selecting Twin Swords in your Storage Chest as Lann will transform them into Twin Spears, and selecting Twin Spears will transform them into Twin Swords.)

However, weapons that cannot be used by the current character cannot be transformed.(Example: Lann cannot transform a Soulblade into Twin Swords or Twin Spears.)

Characters without secondary weapons cannot use the Weapon Transformation feature.

Once a weapon has been selected and confirmed for transformation, the transformed weapon will be sent to the character's mailbox.

Switching primary/secondary weapons costs gold equal to the Equipment Transfer Fee and the Equipment Transfer cooldown is applied.

[img src="https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max"]

Hello, this is the Vindictus team.

Below are the list of changes available after the version update on July 15th, 2025.

 

Table of Contents

1. Character Utility Improvements

Vella - Common

Vella - Twin Swords

Vella - Twin Chainblades

Evie - Battle Scythe

2. Items

3. New Currency: Airgead

4. Misc.

 
[hr][/hr]
1. Character Utility Improvements

\[Vella]

1) Common

Improved the appearance of the character's face.

You can read more about these improvements in our previous notice \[Here]
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td]
Developer's Notes

We've been listening closely to all the valuable feedback you've shared regarding Vella's face model renewal.

Vindictus operates on a single global build, meaning core assets like character models are the same for all regions.
This makes it difficult for us to adjust the NA/EU/ update schedule for contents that has already been applied elsewhere, and we sincerely ask for your understanding.

We completely understand that the new look may not be to everyone's preference.
With that in mind, we've prepared a small gift to show our appreciation: We will be giving a 'Premium Appearance Alteration Coupon' to everyone who logs in, and we hope it helps you customize Vella's new appearance to better match your own personal style.

As always, we sincerely thank you for your incredible passion and support for Vindictus.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

2) Twin Swords

Changed Cross Stance to grant an additional 50 SP if you hit an enemy with a Pure Cross Cut within 40 frames of using it.

Made a fix so that attacks that did not activate Cross Cut prior to this change are able to be blocked while in Cross Stance.

Adjusted the Blade Heart status effect by one stage.

Changed the existing stage 3 effect, "Recover 2 STA on hit, gain 14 ATT SPD", to a base stage effect.

The icon for the Blade Heart status effect will be changed to the old stage 2 icon.

Changed the Blade Heart status effect by removing its duration, allowing it to last for an unlimited amount of time.

However, the status effect will still disappear if you are hit while under its effect.

Changed Active: Wind Rider to no longer consume Blade Heart when used.

Changed Active: Wind Rider to restore 250 SP when used while under the Blade Heart status effect.

The Blade Heart status effect has been consolidated into a single stage, changing the way SP is recovered as opposed to being based on the stage of the Blade Heart status effect.

Changed the cooldown time of Active: Wind Rider from 5 seconds to 15 seconds.

Changed the SP consumption of Active: Sword's Will from 500 to 250.

Adjusted the Blade Heart status effect gained from using Active: Sword's Will to 'Recover 3 STA on hit, gain 15 ATT SPD.' (Previous Effect: 'Recover 2 STA on hit, gain 14 ATT SPD')

The icon for the Blade Heart status effect gained from using Active: Sword's Will will display as the old stage 3 icon.

Added a Super Armor effect to the Gust Sting skill animation.

Changed the STA consumption of Slipaway and Backlash from 20 to 10.

Changed Cross Cut to be usable on attacks that previously did not activate Cross Cut.

The attack above will always activate as Pure Cross Cut.

Adjusted the skill damage increase for Blade Heart to the following:

3) Twin Chainblades

Changed the cooldown time of Active: Red Blizzard from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.

Changed Active: Red Blizzard to grant the new status effect, Bloodstain, when used.

While affected by Bloodstain, using Active: Frostbite will restore 500 SP, then remove the status effect.

Changed the SP consumption of Active: Frostbite from 500 to 100.

Increased the horizontal width of Active: Glacial Strike's attack range by 1.3 times.

Added evasive frames to the second and third attacks of Active: Blade Dance.

Changed the STA consumption of Glint Rank A from 11 to 10.

Changed skill descriptions to match the changes to Vella - Twin Chainblades.

 

\[Evie]

Changed Blade Shift and Demon Splitter so that they create a Spirit Bind when used.

Added evasive frames to Horrific Scream, Soul Skewer, and Dimensional Loom.

Changed Blink so that drains are still possible when it is used after Soul Skewer and Dimensional Loom's additional attacks.

Added an evasive frame to the drain animation.

Changed Active: Void Star so that when used, it reduces the cooldown time of Active: Arcane Gate by 10 seconds.

Changed Active: Void Star, so that after use, Blink can be chained after 55 frames, instead of 83.

Changed the SP consumption of Active: Void Star from 250 to 125.

Changed the SP consumption of Active: Insane Reaper from 500 to 300.

Fixed an issue where being hit by an enemy while using Active: Arcane Gate would intermittently cancel the skill.

2. Items

It is now possible to receive battle completion gold rewards when using Resenlian's Battle Completion Scroll.

When using the Battle Completion Scroll, you can view the estimated gold reward in the pop-up UI.

As before, you can choose whether to apply a Core Boost, and your gold rewards will be adjusted accordingly.

Gold rewards are adjusted based on whether the secondary mission from the previous battle was met.

 
[hr][/hr]
3. New Currency: Airgead

With the July 15th update, the secondary currency: Airgead, will be available in the North American and European servers.

Airgead can be used to purchase in-game gold through the Gold Trading Post, or to purchase cash items in the Supply Depot and Avatar Shop.

You can hold up to 2.1 billion Airgead at once.

Airgead must be moved from the NX Storage Chest to the Storage Chest after purchasing to be used for recharging.

Find more details on how to obtain and use Airgead in our previous notice \[Here]

1. Gain the "Lucky Sprint" Boon when playing Raid battles during the event.

Hello, this is the Vindictus team.
Below are the list of changes available after the version update on May 20th, 2025.

1. Season 4, Episode 11: A prophecy that cannot be followed
Raid Battle: A prophecy that cannot be followed
Added a new raid battle, 'A Prophecy That Cannot Be Followed: Morgant'
Up to 4 players at Lv. 120 can participate in the battle, located in the Fort Cessair region under Toward Taratha.
This battle can be successfully completed once per day.You will consume 16% Fatigue Points when you depart.ATT and M. 19 New Neamhain voice emote has been added.Don't Waste MoneySo Many Regrets...A Carriage Ride?A DuelOvercome EvilWe Exist?The First QuestionBow DownYour SalvationSea of ReflectionNeed the MoneyTries to Get ByStand as OneAnd Yet...AstoundingHear My Prayer!Use Your HeadVibrant and SophisticatedWhich 50?The emotes can be acquired at the "Friendship Seal" Exchange Shop.

Dan-ah
Fixed an issue where when Dan-Ah attacked certain normal monsters utilizing Guard, using the "Final Gate: Purge," "Final Gate: Vanquisher," "Final Gate: Ascendance," and "Final Gate: Unleashed" skills, these attacks did not have damage decrease effect applied.

Neamhain

Fixed an issue where Neamhain would sometimes be unaffected by monster attacks.


Charon
Adjusted the amount of SP gained on the 5th and 6th hits of the third smash attack after "Rune Spectrum," from 5 SP each to 8 SP each.Fixed an issue where, after Charon's third smash attack had its hit count changed, SP recovery should have been adjusted to match the hit count but was not.

Kai
Fixed an issue where using "Ricochet Shot" after "Magnum" would cause Kai's arm to shake.

Character Moods
Added "A Prophecy That Cannot Be Followed" to the Lv. 110+ Region Raid completion requirements for the Mood Mission "Royal Army Request."
 

5. Misc.
Improved logic to address an issue where some party members would occasionally fail to earn rewards, if the party leader left the party shortly after the end of a battle.
Fixed an issue that caused stats on Neamhain weapons below Lv. 90 to be based on ATT instead of M. ATT.

Added a warning pop-up when attempting to use an Extraction Rune on Lv. 110+ equipment.

Changed the level threshold for displaying a warning pop-up when dismantling items from Lv. 90+ -> Lv. 110+.

notes.title: Ver. 3.23 Update Note
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q2/1014/updatebanner.png?width=1000&height=&mode=max

Hello, this is the Vindictus team.
Below are the list of changes available after the version update on April 22nd, 2025.

Table of Contents
[olist]Character Utility UpdatesGame Loading ScreenMisc.[/olist]
 
1. Character Utility Updates

Lann - Common

 Added a new status effect to Critical Break.
 If you do not get a Critical hit with a Smash attack, you gain the 'CRIT RTE Boost' status effect.
 This status effect stacks and increases your next attack's Critical value based on its stage. 
 Your maximum Critical limit does not apply to the increase gained from the CRIT RTE Boost status effect.
 Once you land a Critical hit, the status effect is removed.
[table][tr][td]Effect Stack Stage[/td][td]Effect[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]CRIT RTE +3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]CRIT RTE +10[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]CRIT RTE +30[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 4[/td][td]CRIT RTE +100[/td][/tr][/table]

Developer's Notes
[table][tr][td]In the previous utility improvements, certain values from Lann's CRIT RTE Boost were changed from the previous 22% to 15%. It was a fix related to the sentiment that Lann should be able to forgo 7% of CRIT RTE.
However, after the change above was applied, there were situations where the core skill 'Gliding Fury' was difficult to use, as CRIT RTE might not be applied properly in situations where your equipment was not ready yet.

This new status effect is to prevent this from happening, and make it so that the Gliding Fury skill can be used more smoothly even with a lack of CRIT RTE stats.
This change will have a greater effect on players who lack CRIT RTE than those who have enough, but we expect that raising the CRIT RTE stat to its maximum will still increase DPS in a meaningful way.[/td][/tr][/table]


Lann - Twin Spears

 The dodge range will apply to its maximum 39 frames regardless of Spear Dash skill rank.
 Fixed an issue where you could not use Spear Dash in succession.
 Changed the amount of Stamina consumed when using Spear Dash.
[table][tr][td]Rank[/td][td]Stamina Consumption on Dodge (Previous)[/td][td]Stamina Consumption on Dodge (After)[/td][td]Stamina Consumption on simultaneous Dodge[/td][/tr][tr][td]F[/td][td]15[/td][td]16[/td][td]23[/td][/tr][tr][td]E[/td][td]15[/td][td]15[/td][td]22[/td][/tr][tr][td]D[/td][td]14[/td][td]14[/td][td]21[/td][/tr][tr][td]C[/td][td]13[/td][td]13[/td][td]20[/td][/tr][tr][td]B[/td][td]12[/td][td]12[/td][td]19[/td][/tr][tr][td]A[/td][td]11[/td][td]11[/td][td]18[/td][/tr][tr][td]9[/td][td]10[/td][td]10[/td][td]17[/td][/tr][tr][td]8[/td][td]9[/td][td]9[/td][td]16[/td][/tr][tr][td]7[/td][td]8[/td][td]8[/td][td]15[/td][/tr][tr][td]6[/td][td]7[/td][td]7[/td][td]14[/td][/tr][/table]
 Made improvements to when Spear Dash couldn't be used during knockback animation.
 Spear Dash can be used within a minimum of 20 - 30 frames based on the animation. (Configured the same as Lann - Twin Swords)
 For other animations that occur after being hit(e.g.,kneeling or rolling backwards), Spear Dash cannot be used until the animation ends.
 Fixed an issue where the 'Blood Pact' status effect was not applied.
 'Blood Pack' is now applied even if only the first hit of Belclaire lands on the enemy.


Fiona - Common

 Fixed an issue where the 'Slashing High' status effect could not be obtained.
 'Slashing High' can now be obtained even when quickly chaining into guard or dodge as your character uses Active: Shield Charge and charges.
 

Fiona - Long Hammer

 Shortened the time it takes to build up power to 45% when using Stigma Hammer.
 Fixed an issue where repeatedly right-clicking during the combo that chains Butterfly Swing, Stigma Hammer, and Honeybee Sting charging attacks unintentionally causes the combo to end and Honeybee Sting to activate.
 Fixed an issue where the attack range of Stigma Hammer does not change.
 The attack range of Stigma Hammer will now change based on the time spent building up power.
[table][tr][td]Stigma Hammer Charge Stage[/td][td]Attack Range[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]Same as before[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]8% Increase[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]16% Increase[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 4[/td][td]33% Increase[/td][/tr][/table]
 Adjusted the frames that transition to Normal Attack, Guard, and Dodge immediately after gathering maximum power and attacking when using Stigma Hammer, to the following.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack[/td][td]After 74 frames[/td][td]After 40 frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Guard[/td][td]After 61 frames[/td][td]After 40 frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dodge[/td][td]After 74 frames[/td][td]After 40 frames[/td][/tr][/table]


Fiona - Longsword

 Fixed an issue where Guard couldn't be used before the Rose Thorns usage animation ended, to now be available after 28 frames.
 Fixed an issue where Normal Attacks couldn't be chained smoothly when pressing the Normal Attack Shortcut Key while Ivy Sweep's final attack is in progress. 
 Fixed an issue where Normal Attack couldn't be chained smoothly when pressing the Normal Attack Shortcut Key in advance while Amaranth Kick's final attack was in progress. 
 Fixed an issue where Normal Attack couldn't be chained smoothly after using Ivy Sweep and Amaranth Kick.


Karok - Cestus

 The time in which Absorb Shock is applied when using Normal Attack has been adjusted to the following.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 1x[/td][td]0 - 28 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 2x[/td][td]0 - 20 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 3x[/td][td]0 - 28 Frames[/td][td]0 - 35 Frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 4x[/td][td] 0 -38 Frames[/td][td]0 - 41 Frames[/td][/tr][/table]
 When a Big Bang projectile lands on a target and explodes, the radius of the explosion has been increased by approximately 50%.
 Changed the Full Force activation skill from Big Bang to Active: Hurricane.
 Made a fix so that your character does not get knocked down even after being hit by an enemy's attack between 0-71 frames when using Active: Hurricane.
 Adjusted the SP consumption of Active: Raging Volcano from 250 SP to 200 SP.
 Adjusted the SP consumption of Active: Gigantic Strength from 400 SP to 350 SP.
 Made improvements so that, when using the Big Bang skill, the launch direction is aimed toward the enemy when an enemy is within a certain angle of line of sight.
 Added an effect to the Overheat status effect that increases Active: Hurricane damage by 60%.
 Added information on Overheat to the skill description of Active: Hurricane
 

Kai - Bow

 Increased the SP obtained when using Normal Attacks in Shortbow state from 20 to 30.
 Fixed the effect of Deft, the status effect obtained by using Strafe Shot.
 Removed the stacking stages of the status effect, and made fixes so that the previous Stage 3 effect applies immediately upon obtaining the status effect.
 Changed the information about Deft in the Strafe Shot skill description.
 Increased the SP gained when using Twister Kick and Gale Kick while you have the Deft status effect.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Twister Kick[/td][td]Recover 30 / 40 / 45 SP per Deft Stage[/td][td]Recove 50 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gale Kick[/td][/tr][/table]
 Made a fix so that the character moves backward 70% less when the Move Forward Shortcut Key is pressed while using Magnum.
 You can briefly use the short distance you get knocked back if you press the Move Forward Shortcut Key at the time the arrow is fired.
 Otherwise, you will be pushed back the same distance as before.
 Made a fix so that your character moves backward 70% less when the Move Forward Shortcut Key is pressed at the same time Active: Ricochet Shot is fired after using Magnum.
 Otherwise, you will be pushed back the same distance as before.
 Fixed an issue where the fired arrow got lost when chaining Active: Ricochet Shot after using Magnum Stage 3 while close to a wall.
 Adjusted the frames in which the dodge hitbox takes effect when Dodge is used from 0-32 frames to 0-37 frames.
 Made a fix so that the dodge hitbox is applied for 0-31 frames when using Twister Kick.
 Adjusted the SP consumption of Active: Chain Link from the previous 250 to 0.
 Added the new status effect Chain Link CRIT RTE, through which the activation probability of Hunter's Eye is adjusted to 100% for 20 seconds when using Active: Chain Link.
 Changed the cooldown time of Active: Chain Link from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
 Added information regarding the status effect in the Active: Chain Link skill description.
 Changed the Special Dodge Shortcut Key for Active: Dodge Grapple to the following.
 Fixed the skill preview video and status effect description according to the changes to the new shortcut key.[table][tr][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Use the Dodge Shortcut Key right before Dodge Grapple ends[/td][td]Use the Kick Shortcut Key right before Dodge Grapple ends[/td][/tr][/table]
 Made a fix so that the Chain Link skill cannot have Waking Stone: Efficient SP applied, as the skill's SP consumption has been removed.
 If your existing character's Chain Link skill currently has the "Efficient SP" Waking Stone applied, the applied Waking Stone will be changed to Efficient SP (30) and the "awakening failure" state.
 It will be changed to an "awakening failure" state to prevent the skill's max awakening info from being removed if the skill's Waking Stone info is also removed.
 Also changed to the lowest rank's Efficient SP (30) so that there is no limit for applicable ranks if you switch to a different Skill Awakening Stone in the future.
 Based on the changes above, the following rewards will be distributed via mail to players who meet the distribution criteria:
 [Distribution Criteria] If "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" is applied to the Chain Link skill during the scheduled 4/22 (Thu) maintenance
[table][tr][td]Item Name[/td][td]Quantity[/td][td]Tradability[/td][/tr][tr][td]The "Waking Stone: Efficient SP" that was applied[/td][td]1[/td][td]Bound to Character[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (40%)[/td][td]2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Assuring Erg (20%)[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][tr][td]Skill Awakening Delimiter Erg (60%)[/td][td]1[/td][/tr][/table]
 

Hurk - Teide

 Fixed the time it takes to fire all 6 shells when rapidly left-clicking after using Active: True Shot from approximately 6 seconds to approximately 3.5 seconds.
 Made improvements so that when using Reload Stance at least Rank F while all 8 rounds are loaded, all 8 rounds become Enhanced Bullets.
 Updated the Enhanced Bullet loading info in the Reload Stance skill description.
 The frames where Spinning Slash can offset enemies' attacks have been changed to the following. 
[table][tr][td]Previous[/td][td]Test Server[/td][td]Official Server[/td][/tr][tr][td]0 - 20 Frames[/td][td]0 - 55 Frames[/td][td]0 - 45 Frames[/td][/tr][/table]


Lynn - Battleshade

 Increased the SP gain from Normal Attacks, Petal to the Metal, and Fight and Flight.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack[/td][td]Gain 2 SP[/td][td]Gain 8 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack 2x[/td][td]Gain 3 SP[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Petal the the Metal[/td][td]Gain 25 SP[/td][td]Gain 35 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fight and Flight[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][td]Gain 15 SP[/td][/tr][/table]
 The attack range of Normal Attacks and Smashes below, as well as certain Active Skills, have been increased to the following.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Range Increase[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x1[/td][td]+ 50%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x2[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x3[/td][/tr][tr][td]Normal Attack x4[/td][/tr][tr][td]Petal to the Metal[/td][/tr][tr][td]Metal Blossom[/td][/tr][tr][td]Additional hits of Full Tilt Canopy and Spiked Ferrule after Fight and Flight[/td][/tr][tr][td]Flora Break[/td][/tr][tr][td]Additional hits of Full Tilt Canopy and Spiked Ferrule after Flora Break[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Iron Breeze[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Sudden Gust[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Paranormal Parasol[/td][td]+ 100%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fight and Flight[/td][/tr][/table]
 Adjusted the hit count of the Active Skills below.
 Increased the damage per hit so that the overall damage amount of the Active Skills with adjusted hit counts does not decrease.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Paranormal Parasol[/td][td]16[/td][td]8[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Iron Breeze[/td][td]7[/td][td]2[/td][/tr][/table]
 Made a fix so that your character does not get knocked down even after being attacked upon unleashing the additional hits that follow Active: Flora Break, Full Tilt Canopy, and Spiked Ferrule.
 Made a fix so that using Iron Breeze after Active: Paranormal Parasol does not consume SP.
 Using Iron Breeze by itself consumes 100 SP like before.
 Changed the information regarding SP in the Active: Paranormal Parasol skill description. 
 Increased the damage of Active: Paranormal Parasol and Active: Iron Breeze by 50% compared to the previous official server. However, the first hit damage of Active: Iron Breeze has been decreased by 25%.
 Increased the damage of Active: Sudden Gust by 200% compared to the previous official server.
 Reduced the time needed for the hitbox to take effect after Active: Downpour of Death is used. ("After 70 frames" → "After 40 frames")
 Fixed the animation that rotated the character to face the opposite direction during Fight and Flight's final smash animation.
 Moves forward and deals damage while maintaining the direction that your character is facing. 
 You can change the direction in which the character moves by using the directional keys while the character is rotating during the Fight and Flight animation.
 Fixed the skill preview video based on the changes to the Fight and Flight skill animation.
 Made a fix so that Full Force can be activated when hitting an enemy with Fight and Flight.
 

Developer's Notes
[table][tr][td]Active: Iron Breeze is a skill that can be used as a means of movement, and it consumes less SP than Active: Sudden Gust and has a shorter cooldown.
When comparing the current damage of the two skills, the damage of Active: Iron Breeze was unintentionally excessive, so we made adjustments to decrease it.
While making the adjustments above, we also increased the damage of Active: Sudden Gust so that there is not a significant change to the character's overall performance.[/td][/tr][/table]
 

Arisha - Spellwhip

 Changed the frames in which the guard hitbox takes effect when using the A Battuta skill from 0-16 frames to 0-25 frames, based on the max rank.
 Fixed the chain timing from 0-15 frames (after Crescendo is used) to 0-25 frames, to allow for easier chaining of Prestissimo after Crescendo.
 Adjusted the chain timing to allow for easier chaining of A Battuta after Crescendo. ("After 25 frames" → "After 16 frames")
 Made a fix so that Mana Agrément can also be used after Prestissimo.
 Made a fix so that 10 STA is recovered after successfully attacking an enemy using the Mana Agrément skill.
 Made a fix so that 20 STA is recovered after successfully attacking an enemy using the Mana Agrément (Enhanced Attack) skill.
 Updated the Mana Agrément skill description based on these changes.
 Increased the hit range of Mana Capriccio by 33%.
 Made a fix so that Breathless Rush stacks don't decrease even after being attacked when the status effect is at 16 stacks or more.
 Made a fix so that MP is not consumed when using Accentato while Breathless Rush is at 20 stacks.
 Made a fix so that Breathless Rush gains stacks based on the number of times Active: Staccato Burst hits the enemy.
 The Breathless Rush status effect that's gained through Active: Staccato Burst can be stacked past 10, regardless of Mana Bis usage.
 Updated the Active: Staccato Burst skill description based on the changes.
 Made a fix so that stacks of Breathless Rush can still be obtained even after gaining 10 stacks from using Active: Fierce Rondo.
 Updated the information regarding stacks in the Active: Fierce Rondo skill description.
 Made a fix so that the skill Crescendo can be used immediately after the first hit of Stringendo Strike.
 Made a fix so that Crescendo cannot be chained from the third hit on. Instead, Marcato Rush can be used to chain after using Stringendo Strike.
 Crescendo can still chain during the first and second hits like before. 
 Fixed the dodge periods that take effect when using Mana Agrément after successfully blocking an enemy's attack with A Battuta. 
[table][tr][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]62 - 69 Frames[/td][td]0 - 39 Frames[/td][/tr][/table]
 Fixed the dodge period that applies when using Receding Interlude from 0-23 frames to 0-45 frames based on max rank.
 Made improvements so that Mana Agrément can be used while also using Receding Interlude.
 The Mana Agrément that's chained while using Receding Interlude activates a Mana Agrément that's used when dodging.
 Made a fix so that the icon for the Breathless Rush status effect is displayed separately at the bottom of the boss monster's tenacity gauge.
 Fixed an issue where Breathless Rush, an important status effect for gameplay, couldn't be seen when the number of status effects applied to the character was above a certain amount.
 Now, the status effect is displayed in a separate area, and you can drag it to your preferred location.


Miri

 Slightly increased the time in which the guard hitbox takes effect upon your first and second hits of Parrying Attack.
[table][tr][td]Hitbox[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]First Hit's Guard Hitbox[/td][td]0 - 27 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][tr][td]Second Hit's Guard Hitbox[/td][td]0 - 27 Frames[/td][td]0 - 30 Frames[/td][/tr][/table]
 Changed the recovery time of when the Flamebreath gauge is entirely used up from 12 seconds to 7 seconds.
 Fixed the SP consumption of Active: Ancestral Garb from 300 to 200. 
 Fixed by reducing the Wyvern Magic status effect's stages from 5 to 3. Also made improvements so that getting hit won't reduce your stage.
 Made a fix so that releasing the absorbed energy from successful Parrying Attacks can be used at Wyvern Magic stage 1 instead of 3.
[table][tr][td]Wyvern Magic Stage[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 1[/td][td]No effect, not consumed even upon a successful Parrying Attack[/td][td]Gain 10 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 2[/td][td]No effect, not consumed even upon a successful Parrying Attack[/td][td]Gain 35 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 3[/td][td]Adds additional damage 3 times, adds 90 STA & 90 SP[/td][td]Gain 15 SP[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 4[/td][td]Adds additional damage 4 times, adds 120 STA & 120 SP[/td][td] [/td][/tr][tr][td]Stage 5[/td][td]Adds additional damage 5 times, adds 150 STA & 150 SP[/td][td] [/td][/tr][/table]
 Changed the Parrying Attack skill description based on the Wyvern Magic stage adjustments.
 Made the Active: Blazing Spine projectiles that fly towards enemies 3 times faster.


Kael

 Increased the max stage of the Brilliance status effect from 10 to 15.
 Added an effect that recovers 25 STA when hitting an enemy with Guardian's Blade: Counter.
 You do not recover stamina from attacks that use additional controls, only when you successfully hit an enemy with the first attack.
 Adjusted the stages of Guardian's Blade: Strike that chain after using each skill as the following.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Previous[/td][td]After[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Resistance Unchained[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Low Flight[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Demos Uprising[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Active: Rhythmic Radiance[/td][td]Third hit[/td][td]Fourth hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thunderbird Slash[/td][td]Second hit[/td][td]Third hit[/td][/tr][tr][td]Eagle Flight[/td][td]Second hit[/td][td]Third hit[/td][/tr][/table]
 

Charon

 Fixed an issue where the final smash attack hit that led to Hex: Luchia would not occur when using Rune Spectrum while your ATT SPD was above a certain value.
 Adjusted the camera perspective available when determining Active: Moonlight's range, so a wider view can be seen while using it.
 Adjusted the camera location so that Active: Moonlight can be used from a field of vision that's wider than before.
 Adjusted the default aiming location when using Active: Moonlight.
 While previously adjusting the camera used when aiming, an issue was discovered where the default aiming location after the skill is cast was shifted to directly in front of the character, making it difficult to use. The location has now been restored to what it was previously.


Neamhain

 Decreased the damage of the following skills.
[table][tr][td]Skill Name[/td][td]Damage Decrease[/td][/tr][tr][td]Blink Pike[/td][td]- 10%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rapid Pike[/td][/tr][tr][td]Gale Slash[/td][/tr][tr][td]Rapid Pierce[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ascension Slash[/td][/tr][tr][td]Smite the Wicked[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Slash[/td][td]- 18%[/td][/tr][tr][td]Divine Slash (Advent State)[/td][/tr][tr][td]Heaven Impact[/td][/tr][/table]


2. Game Screen

 The spring theme for the game's starting screen, Colhen, Rocheste, and Malina will end.
 Cherry blossom trees will no longer appear in the center of Colhen.
 The spring theme for the in-game event notifications will also end.


3. Misc.

 Added the Photo Studio emote to the Emote UI.
 The equipment share and transfer cooldown will reset.
 Adjusted the amount of gold obtainable by clearing the sub stories to correspond with the amount obtainable from the main story.

notes.title: Ver. 3.22 Update Note
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Vindictus team.
Below are the list of changes available after the version update on March 25th, 2025.

Table of Contents
[olist]Changes to Event NotificationsStory Skip FunctionTemporary Guild SupportIn-Game Spring Seasonal ThemeSpecial Spring Log-in GiftBug Fix[/olist]


1. Changes to Event Notifications
The Event Notification UI has been improved into a calendar format.
The new Event Notification calendar supports both schedules for current events and upcoming events.
Upcoming events are subject to change / cancel before their release, depending on their circumstances.A new feature, 'Permanent Event Menu' has been added.Events ongoing permanently can be viewed from the new menu.

2. Story Skip Function
The Story Skip function is now available.A previous title, "Title: Rocheste Tourist" has been added to the Ancient Title Destiny Box.

3. Temporary Guild Support
From March 25th to April 29th, Guild House Dues will be discounted.During the period, all Guild House Dues will have an additional 5% off. The discount will be applied to the following month.GP obtained from Guild Missions will be doubled during the support period.

4. In-game Spring Seasonal Theme
From March 25th to April 22nd, the in-game theme will be changed to Spring maps.The main starting screen will change to spring seasonal theme.Colhen / Rocheste / Malina are subject to change.Desolate Malina will not be changed.When moving to Colhen / Rocheste, the loading screen will be changed to the spring theme.The lobby loading screen before the Colhen quest departure will be changed to the spring theme.New character Friendship lines have been added.

5. Special Spring Log-in Gift
From March 25th to April 22nd, upon logging in with a character Lv.1+ you will receive a "Dance of Flowers Effect Box" via mail.

[Item Details]
[table][tr][td]Item Name[/td][td]Claimable Character[/td][td]Expiration[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Female / Male[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Karok[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dance of Flowers (30 Days)[/td][td]Hurk / Grimden[/td][td]30 days[/td][/tr][/table]

6. Bug Fix

[Battle]

Fixed an issue where the enchant effect applying even in situations when you cannot use Artifacts, like when you are holding an item, aiming a secondary weapon, etc.

Fixed an isssue where characters getting stuck when going up the hill after entering the battle region for "The One Who Protects the Altar."
Fixed an issue where the map brightness appears unnatural when entering the battle region for "The One Who Protects the Altar."Fixed an issue where the light pillar effect did not show when obtaining "Uaithne Fragment: The Cursed Belt" in "Glutton's Banquet."Fixed an issue where the light pillar effect did not show when obtaining an "Outfit Recipe Scroll" in a Special Dungeon.

[Misc.]
Fixed an issue where the user could not obtain an AP 500 capsule upon completing the story 'Getaway.'Fixed an issue where the story repeats itself from the beginning when selecting "No" for a Redeemers story branch.


As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.
Thank you for supporting Vindictus!

notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1438/ingame_loadingbanner_1920x663.jpg?width=1285&height=444&mode=max

Event Period ∥ Feb 4th, 2025 (After Maintenance) - Feb 18th, 2025 (Before Maintenance)
Exchange Shop Period ∥ Feb 4th, 2025 (After Maintenance) - Feb 25th, 2025 (Before Maintenance)

(* Per Character Event)

 

Event Details

1. Complete the guide story through the Strange Traveler to obtain one Sweet Chocolate Box.

- The Sweet Chocolate Box contains one Sweet Chocolate that can be gifted to Friendship NPCs, and three Love Each Day! Valentine Coupons.

- The NPC who receives the Sweet Chocolate will reward one Friendship Seal in return.

- When you gift the chocolate to any character 10 times, you can achieve the Friendship Achievement, [Event: Love Each Day! Valentine's].

- If you achieve the Friendship Achievement, you can obtain [Title: Spreading Love Everyday] as a reward.

2. Complete all daily missions during the event period to obtain one Sweet Chocolate Box.

3. Love Each Day! Valentine Coupons can be exchanged for items at the Exchange Shop.

notes.title: [Letter from Allanon] Have a happy New Year in this year of the Blue Snake!
notes.content:
Hello, this is DEV Allanon.

 

It seems like just a few days ago we welcomed the new year of 2025, and soon a month will have passed.

I am sending you my New Year's greetings, even though they're late.

 

[New Character Neamhain and Golden Time Event]

It hasn't been long since we introduced the new character Neamhain, the boss monster Gorbas of the Glutton's Banquet, and Golden Time.

You've given us a lot of feedback, suggestions, and recommendations, and we've carefully reviewed it all.

In order to resolve the inconvenient parts of Neamhain's character, we made an additional update yesterday, January 23rd. We will also check to see if any other inconveniences remain.

There were many concerns that Neamhain might have been over-tuned, but we decided to fix her by prioritizing playability and comfort.

If objective indicators show other adjustments are needed during future balance updates, we will approach them cautiously.

There was a lot of feedback and suggestions regarding Neamhain, but there was much more buzz regarding the Golden Time event.

There were voices of support for the Golden Time item rewards and many valuable comments on the event's change to a designated-day attendance check method.

We agree with each and every one of your opinions and believe they are valid. Based on the feedback and event data you have carefully written, we will consider ways to satisfy even more players in future Golden Time events.

 

[Mileage Shop]

There were also many inquiries about the Mileage Shop.

We think the Mileage Shop, which we are planning on adding in the July or August update, could replace the NX Reward event.

When you purchase items with NX, you will receive a certain amount of mileage points, and these points can be used to purchase desired items at the Mileage Exchange Shop, which is always open.

It will include some of the outfits previously featured in the NX Reward event, along with the Bres, Eisen Ritter outfits, Wings, and Back Ornament items.

In addition to outfits, we will work on customizing the product list to provide more options for purchasing items, including NX items such as Enhancement Runes or Enchant Runes.

In fact, the most common inquiry about the Mileage Shop is about the commonization of exclusive hair.

The commonization of exclusive hair is an item prepared as a special benefit only available at the Mileage Shop. We plan to make hairstyles that can only be worn by specific characters available to all characters of the same gender.

Since Hurk, Grimden, and Karok have different body types from other male characters, we are reviewing whether their hair can be shared, and we will push forward in a direction where they can while preserving our original intentions as much as possible.

We have also confirmed the suggestion to proceed with the commonization of Exclusive Equipment etc., but please note that we are currently only proceeding with plans for hair.

 

[Recollection Crystal]

We also reviewed the discontinuation of the Recollection Crystal, which many of you suggested.

The Recollection Crystals, which were to provide a chance to obtain outfits that you unfortunately missed, will no longer be provided.

We have made this decision in agreement with the feedback of many players who shared negative experiences, which goes against our original intention.

 

[Character Utility Improvements] 

While opinions on Golden Time events, hair commonization, and Recollection Crystals tended to gather attention at certain points in time, the most consistent suggestions were for character utility improvements.

The first character utility improvement update of the year is currently in the works and targeted for release in March.

In March, we plan to resolve the unreasonable play structure as before, by slightly modifying several characters.

We plan to modify characters like Lynn using the Battleshade, Arisha using the Spellwhip, Fiona using the Long Hammer, Cestus Karok, Kael, Hurk using the Teide, and Kai using the Bow.

After the March update, the next update is expected to be around June.

We will start by focusing on improving Vella, who uses the Twin Swords and Twin Chainblades, and then sequentially work on characters that need a lot of improvement. 

We ask for your understanding from players who use Vella, and we will proceed meticulously to get good results.

 

We will prepare a detailed explanation of the schedule and the contents of the updates we're unable to introduce one by one in the DevTalk before the summer update.

That DevTalk is scheduled to be released around March, but if it is delayed, we will share our progress through DevComments.

 

As this is a meaningful year that began with meeting our players face-to-face, we will work even harder to become a Vindictus that always listens to our players' voices.

Have a happy New Year in this year of the Blue Snake!

 

And thank you!

 

NOTICE
The above information and schedule are based on the Korean server. Please note that this includes parts that have not yet been implemented, such as improvements to Neamhain and the new raid.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Planned Changes to VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Items
notes.content:
Hello, this is Vindictus.

We would like to provide prior notice regarding modifications to the Aurora Effect Destiny Box, which was distributed as part of the 2024 NX Reward Event.

 

[Notice Details]

It has been confirmed that the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect displayed in-game differs slightly from the effect described in the 2024 NX Reward Event announcement.

The three VIP Premium Aurora effects showcased on the event page were recorded during the development process.

During the creation of the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora, the blinking effect, which appears during the reactivation of the effect, was deemed unnatural.

To achieve a smoother and more natural visual effect, adjustments were made, resulting in the current Flashing Type (VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora - Pulsing Variant).

 

However, as the current VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant) was provided without adequate explanation beforehand, we plan to resolve this issue by adding a VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Steady Variant) option to the box contents.

This will allow players who selected the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect to choose the type they prefer and prevent any inconvenience.

The details are as follows:

 

[Planned Changes]

※ These changes will take effect after the maintenance on Thursday, February 25th.
[olist]The previously distributed VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect item will be renamed to VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant).The VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora effect item in the Aurora Effect Destiny Box will be replaced with a VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Effect Destiny Box.[/olist]
 

VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Effect Destiny Box
VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant)VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Steady Variant)
 
Players can select and obtain one of the two types: Pulsing Variant or Steady Variant.Descriptions of both effects will be available on the 2024 NX Reward Event page starting February 4th; however, please note that the date is subject to change.Please note that the names "VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant)" and "VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Steady Variant)" are tentative and may change upon final release.
 


[Details by Player Status]
Players who have not opened the Aurora Effect Destiny BoxThe contents of the box will be updated as follows, allowing players to select one of the items:Before February 25th Maintenance:VIP Premium Black AuroraVIP Premium Gold Pentacle AuroraVIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant)After February 25th Maintenance:VIP Premium Black AuroraVIP Premium Gold Pentacle AuroraVIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Effect Destiny BoxPlayers who opened the Aurora Effect Destiny Box and obtained the VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Effect before February 25th MaintenanceThe VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora (Pulsing Variant) in your possession will be retrieved.A VIP Premium Purple Storm Aurora Effect Destiny Box will be sent to you via account mail.
 


We sincerely apologize for the confusion caused during the distribution of rewards for the 2024 NX Reward Event.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Neamhain: The Holy Knight of Conviction
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.

Today we're introducing the 26th hero of Vindictus, Neamhain.

 

Neamhain is a female character who wields the Holy Lance. 

 

The Holy Lance is a weapon characterized by a sharp spearhead and a long handle, and is designed to allow the handle to be folded or unfolded depending on the situation. 

Neamhain can use the Holy Lance to perform actions that combine with magic,

creating powerful strikes that unleash Divinity. 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1305/20250108024505430.jpg

(Neamhain with Holy Lance)

 
Combat Style with the Magic of the Holy Knights
Neamhain uses the Holy Knight's magic to summon a shield to defend against enemy attacks.

Upon defending successfully, you can counterattack with Counter Slash.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1306/2025010802480379.jpg

(Neamhain blocking enemy's attack)

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1307/2025010802484334.jpg

(Counterattacking Neamhain)

 
Powerful Strike Releases Divinity
Full divinity can be contained in the Holy Lance through Embrace Divinity.

When Embrace Divinity is fully charged, you can use Divine Slash.

Divine Slash releases the divinity contained in the Holy Lance all at once, delivering a powerful blow.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1308/20250108024911198.jpg

(Neamhain using Embrace Divinity)

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1309/20250108024943995.jpg

(Neamhain using Divine Slash)

 
Neamhain using Divine Power
Active: Holy Vessel can briefly use the power of the gods to enhance yourself.

When enhanced, your HP is restored, and you move more swiftly.

Additionally, the charge duration of Embrace Divinity is reduced, allowing you to chain Divine Slash more quickly.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2025/q1/1310/2025010802502123.jpg

(Neamhain using Active: Holy Vessel)

 

In addition, there's Active: Ethereal Wave, which enhances you when hitting the enemy,

Active: Gemini Spiral, which allows you to defend and attack at the same time, and other active skills you can utilize in various ways.

 

That's Neamhain, our upcoming 26th hero in Vindictus.

We'll always do our best to provide you with a fun and enjoyable experience.

Thank you for your continued love and support for Vindictus!

notes.title: [CMTY] GM COIN S4: It’s a Gift!
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1806/gm_coin_800x450.png

Event Period: December 17th - January 21st

 

Another year is coming to an end.

Won’t it be nice to prepare a small gift for someone you care for? 

…And won’t it be better if that gift’s something they'll NEVER EXPECT?

 

Show us what you've got in your inventory, that can be the weirdest, and not-so-useful present to someone that comes to your mind!

 

How to participate:

From your inventory, choose an item that you would want to gift to someone.
The item should be something that when gifted, they will not be able to find a decent use for. (In other words, literally an 'useless' gift)

The person to receive the gift can be anyone. From your close friends or family, or a NPC in game, even monsters or bosses. The item too, does not have to be technically tradeable.
The key is 'choosing a weird gift.'

Share the item on our official discord with followings below:
Server:The item you'd like to present:Why you chose that item: 
 

Rewards:

If over 60 people participate, a coupon code containing 15 GM Coins will be revealed.

Otherwise, it will be exclusively disclosed to participants.Plus, from each server(NA/EU), two best participants will be chosen;

They will be given a special reward of extra 10 more GM Coins!

 

Please Note:
Each person can only participate once.Rewards will be given during maintenance on January 21st.Irrelevant posts, Posts not following the given format, or participation with other people's work will not be counted.All Submittions may be used in our official social accounts.Top 2 participants per server will be decided by Nexon Staff.

notes.title: [CMTY] GM Coin S4: VVinter VVardrobe
notes.content:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q4/1446/staem_cover_img_800x450.jpg

 

Event Period

11/19/2024 (Tue) after weekly maintenance - 12/17/2024 (Tue) before weekly maintenance

 

Mercenaries, 

 

Remember our Spring Cleaning Event back in March? 

Now with the air getting chillier, it’s time to dig back out those cozy winter clothes! 

Who knows, maybe we’ll be able to find some we forgot we even owned them? 

Show us your best fashion for this Winter Season!

 

How to Participate
Take a screenshot wearing winter themed or warm-looking clothes.Winter themed clothing: Any clothing that includes a combination of clothing or dyeing that can be associated with the keywords winter, cold, snow, or ice.Warm-looking clothes: Thick, warm clothes that you would actually wear in cold weather.Share the type of clothing and dye information used in the screenshot on our official Discord #vvinter-vvardrobe channel. (Providing dye information is optional)Add a short title or description to the screenshot. (ex. 2024 F/W season hot items)
 

Event Rewards
If more than 70 people participate during the event, 10 GM Coins will be distributed to all players on December 17th.If that number of participants is not reached, then the coupon for 10 GM Coins will be distributed only to those who participated.
 

Information Needed to Participate:
Server:Screenshot:Title or description of the screenshot:Information about the clothes worn:
 

Note:
Screenshots and captions submitted for participation can be used for social posting during the event period and after the event ends.Only one entry per person, multiple entries are not allowed.Irrelevant posts, Posts not following the given format, or participation with other people's work will not be counted.

notes.title: [Letter from Allanon] October Developer's Notes
notes.content:
[The contents in the Developer Notes are based on Korea Service Schedule, Overseas Updates will follow regional timelines] 

   

Dear Mercenaries,

This is DEV Allanon, director of Vindictus. 

  

Today, I’d like to share some exciting updates for the winter season that you might be curious about.  

During the upcoming winter season, we are aiming to update the below sequentially. And will elaborate the current development status one by one.    


 Character Growth Section Renewal  
 The 3rd Space Time Distortion: The Watcher’s Temple  
 26th New Hero Update  


  

[Character Growth Section Renewal]   

The Character Growth Section Renewal is scheduled for November.    

Since there will be some significant changes to familiar gameplay patterns, I’d like to highlight the key aspects that will change, as outlined in this October DEV Note: 







1. Story Progression Process:  

Stories that can be considered as tutorial will be excluded from the main story line, allowing players to focus solely on the main story of Vindictus.  

Players can choose to skip story dialogues; those who opt to skip will no longer need to click through each dialogue to proceed.

However, some dialogues may not offer the skip option. Even so, we’re working to minimize the time required for story progression. 







2. Shortened Battle Progress:  

After skipping the story, players can jump directly to boss battles, bypassing regular monster battles, which will streamline progression and reduce combat time.

I hope this renewal will create a smoother playing experience with more efficient paths and shorter battles.

To avoid making boss battles too quick or mechanical, I also plan to adjust the balance of boss monsters to enhance the leveling experience and deliver enjoyable action gameplay. 

  




3. Revised Rewards in Growth Phase:  

We plan to reduce the amount of gold earned from battles and story completions, replacing lower-value items with items essential for growth.

Equipment, AP, fatigue potions, and other necessities will be provided abundantly in the growth section, supporting players in preparing for raid battles through the main storyline. To offset the reduced gold, various missions and an adjustment in the cost of level 110 enhancements will help maintain smooth progression. 

  




4. Renewed Guide System:  

As character growth paths change, the guide system will be updated accordingly.

Play guide missions can now be completed regardless of stage, and missions such as redeemer clearance requirements will be adjusted to match the faster growth pace.  

  




Additionally, minor updates will be made, such as advancing key skills acquisition times for certain characters, increasing Red Moon’s Energy Battle EXP, and so on. We will continue to monitor feedback from players on these changes. 

  




[Space Time Distortion: The Watcher’s Temple]  

The 3rd Space-Time Distortion, The Watcher’s Temple, is scheduled for November.

The test server will open on November 6th, with the Character Growth Section going live on November 14th and the full Space-Time Distortion update on November 21st.

This schedule allows players to experience the Character Growth Section for one week and the Space-Time Distortion for two weeks on the test server.  




In the first test week, only the initial phases of Space-Time Distortion will be available, with the full battle opening the following week. 

We will gather feedback and fix bugs as needed, addressing critical issues promptly regardless of the update schedule.




Stat requirements for the new Space-Time Distortion will be announced when the test server opens.

To ensure smooth testing, my team and I will patch unintended errors and provide stat-boosting items as needed.  




The diverse attack patterns from Jordra and Jörmungandr will challenge our testers, but I believe our players’ skill will conquer this battle even before the official release. 

The top-tier battle rewards for the 3rd Space-Time Distortion will include new artifacts and exclusive enchantments, granting additional effects based on artifact-enchantment combinations for optimized usage.  




Magic extraction will also become available for the Fallen One’s Rhod Compass, which will remain the highest-tier item without new Rhod Compass additions.  

This new Space-Time Distortion features a more captivating design, and I hope you look forward to its release. 

  




[26th Hero] 

The 26th Heroine is scheduled for release this winter; however, I must announce that the planned December release will be postponed to January 2025.  

After careful consideration, I concluded that a January 2025 release would align better with the 15th Anniversary and Lunar New Year.  

Alongside the new hero release, a Golden Time Event will also occur in January.

Although the release has been delayed, we are preparing a special end-of-year event to celebrate with you. Thank you for understanding this schedule change. 




The 26th Hero marks a fresh attempt by our development team, and while details will be shared at a later time, I appreciate your patience as we finalize this exciting addition. 

Note: For regions outside Korea, the delayed schedule does not apply, and development is proceeding as initially planned. 

  




In early November, we’ll introduce the Recollection Crystal and a 2024 Cashback event, followed by a year-end event in December. January 2025 updates will be further discussed in our December DEV Talk clip. 




As it’s getting colder, I hope everyone stays healthy and keeps the flu at bay. 

Thank you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/19665237b0f9d197088055d55294fac54253c4ca.jpg

Event Period: 9/24/2024 (Mon) after weekly maintenance - 10/15/2024 (Tue) before weekly maintenance

 

Mercenaries,

Is everyone familiar with the game, ‘I spy?’

We come up with an object in mind, and you will be guessing what we’re thinking of!

How familiar with the world of Vindictus are you?

 

Now, it’s time to begin.

I spy with my little eye…

 
Event Info:
Each week, a new quiz will be revealed, starting the timer.
Once the quiz begins, you will have one week to find the exact target that we are thinking of, based on the hint given in the questions.
After a week, the former quiz will be closed, and you will not be able to add any answers.
Answer the question with a screenshot through the comment section of the post with the question.
 
Information Needed to Participate:
ServerThe Answer of the WeekScreenshot of the answer
 

Reward Info:
If over 20 answers are submitted each week, a coupon code containing **10 GM Coins** will be revealed to everyone.Otherwise, it will be exclusively disclosed to participants, regardless of validity of answers.Screenshots and Forum posts submitted may be used in future social posts.You may not participate multiple times.


Please Note:
Each person can only participate once per week.Rewards will be given during maintenance on October 15th.Replies that are irrelevant or participation with other people's screenshots will not be counted.Replies that do not meet the Participation Format will not be counted.Submittions may be used in our official social accounts.

notes.title: [SURVEY] 2024 Recollection Crystal Avatar Preference Survey
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/2799898adf880bb70224425c0a3a05209c491d47.png
 

Dear Mercenaries,

 

The Recollection Crystal is scheduled to be released in the near future!

You can show your preferences by participating in the Recollection Crystal Avatar Preference Survey.

 

Please refer to the details below for more details including how to participate in the survey.

 

[Recollection Crystal Avatar Preference Survey Guide]
Participation Period: From the opening on Thursday, September 12th to Thursday, September 26th at 8:00 AM UTCEligible Avatars: 39 new avatars sold from July 2023 to June 2024How to ParticipateClick here to join the Avatar Preference Survey You can participate once per account through the Avatar Preference Survey link above.You can vote for up to ten avatars from the 39 available.
 

[Notes]
A total of 10 avatars will be selected and released as part of the Recollection Crystal based on the survey results.The survey results will determine the selection of 8 female avatars and 2 male avatars.If a unisex avatar is chosen, it will be included either as one female or one male avatar, and further details will be provided based on the voting results.Please note that the 39 avatars on the survey page are sorted by their release date.To ensure a fair survey environment and free expression of opinions, no intermediate results will be shared during the survey period. We ask for your understanding.
 

We appreciate the participation of all players!

notes.title: [Notice] End of Service Support for Operating Systems Below Windows 10
notes.content:
Dear Mercenaries, 

 

To maintain the stability and security of Vindictus, support for operating systems below Windows 10 has officially ended. 

If you're using an operating system older than Windows 10, please refer to the following information to avoid any disruptions while playing the game. 

 

1. Windows Version Check and Upgrade Guide 
Checking your Windows version Press the Windows logo key + [R] simultaneously to open the Run dialog. Then type "winver" and press Enter to check your current Windows version. 
 

2. Upgrading your Windows version 
If you have a license for Windows 10 or higher, you can upgrade by visiting the following page: [Go to Microsoft Website > Software Download] 
 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and will continue to work hard to provide you with a pleasant gaming experience in Vindictus. 

 

Thank you.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Ver. 3.16 Update Note
notes.content:
Table of Contents
[olist]Character Utility ImprovementsBattle[/olist]
 

1. Character Utility Improvements

The first character utility improvement update for 2024 is being conducted.

 
[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

This character utility improvement consists of 8 characters, with improvements being made on aspects that felt unpleasant or unreasonable when playing as them.

 

While one goal was to minimize changes to how each of these characters operate, there may be some less predictable changes in DPS performance, depending on what was altered. For now, we will keep the power of each skill the same while applying the changes below, but please understand that we may need to adjust the power level of some skills down the road.

 

Additionally, it seems that Sanyaa is performing well in all raids right now, but since it is difficult to apply changes so soon after release, we plan to make appropriate adjustments to her once we have more data. However, we do not plan on changing the structure of the character. We will instead make changes by adjusting her damage output.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

Sylas
When you are attacked by an enemy during the following, the period in which the attack animation does not occur will increase by approximately 24%. Wraith Slash Wraith Shot Phantom Shooter Cyclone Saw
 
Following attacks have an added aspect where Sylas can dodge enemies' attacks. Cyclone Crash  (added 30 frames)  Illusion Fist  (added 33 frames) 
 
Following active skills have an added aspect where Sylas can dodge enemies' attacks.  Active: Impulse Zone (added 45 frames) Active: Illusion Shield (added 35 frames)
 
When the following attacks are successful, the number of Phantom Shards that can be obtained is increased from 2 to 3.  Normal Attack (3rd hit) Normal Attack (4th hit)
 
When the Spirit Rend attack is successful, the amount of stamina recovered is increased from 20 to 35.Fixed the issue where damage was occasionally applied multiple times when attacking with Wraith Slash in battle.When acquiring a Phantom Shard through a normal attack, the duration will be displayed as a status effect.The M. When using Cyclone Crash  and Illusion Fist , the character can now withstand some attacks while charging for the attack.When using Illusion Fist  without inputting a directional key, the distance traveled is decreased. If you input the directional keys you will attack, moving the same distance as before.When Cyclone Crash is used without dodging, while charging for a set duration, additional enhanced attack is activated.When Illusion Fist is used without dodging, while charging for a set duration, additional enhanced attack is activated. Additional enhanced attack can inflict 15% more damage to enemies than a normal enhanced attack.
 

Lynn - Glaive
Killer Dart attack can be used without charging for the following attacks.  Thunderleg Little Rat Wind Step
 
 It will now cost 14 Stamina when chaining the above attacks with Killer Dart.
 
Fixed being able to use Killer Dart without charging (by using Phoenix Feather, etc.) during battle. When using Killer Dart by charging while moving, the fastest time Lynn can activate it (from the moment Lynn begins charging) is increased by approximately 15 frames. When attacking with Killer Dart, the range at which enemies are hit is increased. When you use Killer Dart after Wind Step, the distance the character moves is approximately 50% of the distance of the basic Killer Dart attack.
 
Fixed it so Thunderleg does not chain to Iron Monkey.When attacking with Five Finger Death, the range at which enemies are hit is increased. When attacking with Five Finger Death, if the boss or the last monster hit is nearby, the camera will quickly rotate towards the target and the attack will happen while looking straight ahead. Improved so that when successfully attacking with Fishtail Pole, 2 Swift Assassin Strikes are inflicted.When attacking with Active: Iron Flag, the range of the forward explosion attack is slightly increased.Fixed an issue where key inputs would not apply when using Thunderleg, by rapidly inputting the dodge key in succession while using Active: Jade Fox.The attack range for Active: Chambers of Death is slightly increased.[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

There was an inconvenient and unreasonable structure in place, where effectively using Glaive Lynn required near-exploits, such as using Killer Dart without charging through Phoenix Feathers, to reach her full potential.

 

However, considering that the "Phoenix Feather Play" has been used for a long time now, we modified it so that Killer Dart can be used immediately without charging after a specific action. Due to this update, there's an expected change in performance for the entire player base (including players who did not use the technique) so we will closely monitor her results.
[/td][/tr][/table]
 

Dan-Ah
When using Soul Tracer, the timing to switch to movement is adjusted to be faster without having to dodge or perform other actions.MP Cost for using Soul Tracer is decreased from 70 to 60. When using the Fickle Fate attack, the timing in which the enemy's attack can be offset is increased by 13% compared to previously.When using Soul Barrier, the timing in which you can defend against enemy attacks is increased by 14% compared to previously.When Active: Great Beyond is activated, the range at which enemies are hit is increased.
 
When using Final Gate: Purge and Final Gate: Unleashed, and then using Curse Breaker without inputting a directional key at the same time, the distance traveled is decreased.Improved it so that stamina is recovered by 15 when the Curse Breaker attack is successful.When using Soul Tracer, the period in which you can dodge enemy attacks is increased by 28%. 
 
When using Soul Strike, the range at which enemies can be attacked is slightly increased. The timing for chaining Spirited Dash after attacking an enemy with the additional hit from Soul Strike has been adjusted to be 8 frames faster than before.
 
When using Soul Barrier, the distance Dan-Ah moves backwards is decreased.When using Soul Tracer after successfully defending with Soul Barrier, throwing weapons have improved accuracy. 
 
When using Spirited Dash, MVT SPD is increased by 10% compared to previously. The timing for the dodge hit box is the same as before.When using Active: Ritual of Ending without inputting a directional key at the same time, the forward distance traveled is decreased. If you input the directional keys you will attack, moving the same distance forward as before.
 

 

Delia
