When successfully attacking with Rising Comet, the effect duration of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit are increased by up to 1 second.When successfully attacking with Falling Comet, the effect duration of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit will increase by up to 2 seconds.
 
Updated Full Moon as follows: Updated so that when hitting an enemy with a finisher attack, you gain 20 SP. Updated so that after the finisher attack, it can be chained starting from the second hit of the normal attack. Updated so that when performing a finisher attack, the effect durations of Keen, Perfect Keen, and Fighting Spirit are increased 0.5 seconds.
 
Updated Active: Zenith as follows: Removes the effect of destroying armor when used. Updated Active: Zenith so that it can be used in Royal Army. The duration of the Fighting Spirit and Perfect Keen effects obtained upon use have been adjusted from 120 seconds to 130 seconds each, and the timing at which the effects are applied have been adjusted from after the skill animation has finished to immediately after the skill is used. There was a problem with the Fighting Spirit and Perfect Keen effects sometimes not applying when another animation was played, following the use of Active: Zenith. It has been adjusted as noted above. When using Rising Comet or Falling Comet, while the Fighting Spirit effect still remains after using Active: Zenith, the Vigor effect will be updated to Stage 3.
 
Rising Comet and Falling Comet are added to the Full Force activation requirement.
 
Added a sparkling effect to the tip of the Bastard Sword in the following situations, as well as sound effects. After learning Rising Comet, it can chain from Rings of Saturn. After learning Falling Comet, it can chain from Orbital Flurry. After learning Falling Comet, it can chain from Active: Cosmic Blitz. A dodge hit box is added in above situations, from when the effect begins until the end of the animation.
 
Fixed it so that Wild Star's charge attack always grants the Lv. 1 Vigor effect. If the attack is successful, you will gain 2 additional Vigor stages just like before, allowing you to obtain the Vigor Stage 3 effect.
 
Updated to allow chaining Active: Ion Thrust after the following attacks. Solar Flare Starbloom Lunar AssaultIn accordance with the above changes, the skill description of Active: Ion Thrust will include the types of skills that can be chained.
 
The stamina consumption of Meteor Impact was reduced.[table][tr][td]

[/td][td]

[/td][/tr][/table]Adds the new status effect Rose's Revenge. When Delia successfully blocks an enemy's attack with Eclipse, a red rose effect will appear, and she will gain the Rose's Revenge status effect. This status effect lasts for 20 seconds and increases the damage of the next Rising Comet or Falling Comet by 30%. Added a description of the new status effect, Rose's Revenge, to the skill description of Eclipse.[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes:

The penalty for Delia's powerful Active: Zenith was too strong and made it difficult to use across the game, the cycle took too long to prepare, and the Vigor effect did not fit the current raid meta. It was determined that these aspects were what made playing Delia inconvenient and unreasonable.

 

The effect of her armor being destroyed when using Active: Zenith made it difficult to use in content like Space Time Distortions. 

 

We went back and forth about removing the armor destruction effect because it was Delia's unique concept... but we decided that it was just too harsh for Delia, who lacks defensive mechanics. We ask for understanding from players who prefer her original armor destruction concept. 

 

Additionally, we made a change to continuously renew Vigor effect to stage 3 after using Active: Zenith, while the Fighting Spirit effect is active, so that players can focus on dealing damage while in that state.

 

Also, the Perfect Keen effect was changed to slightly increase in duration when performing certain actions. This should complement Delia's DPS performance in long battles rather than short ones.

 

Delia is currently showing low DPS performance in Redeemers and Space Time Distortion battles, but with the above changes we hope she will be improved somewhat.
[/td][/tr][/table]

The following skills have been updated so they are easier to hit enemies. Hunt Breathing Rhino Rush used after Crocodile Scales
 
Add the following to the skill description for Hunt Breathing. Cheetah Strike can restore Warrior's Claw through a swinging or slashing attack with the lance. The above content simply adds missing parts to the explanation. Restoring Warrior's Claw is the same as before.
 

 

Letty
Updated so that the weak point can be partially destroyed when hitting an enemy with the giant bomb of Active: Letty Bomba, or when dealing damage with the ground explosion effect of the giant bomb.Updated the following skill to enhance the bomb of Active: Firecracker. Dealing damage with Standing Flip or Active: Beautiful Blaze will enhance the bomb by 1 stage.The duration of the bomb attached to an enemy via Active: Firecracker is increased from 15 seconds to 20.
 
When the following attacks hit an enemy within a certain range, damage is increased by 5%. When the damage increase effect is applied, the damage is marked in yellow. Trooper: Crushing Blow, Trooper: Twisting Blow (Normal attack 2 times - Smash Combo) Trooper: Piercing Strike, Trooper: Storm Smite (Normal attack 3 times - Smash Combo) To avoid confusion with the above effect, other damage previously marked in yellow is changed to red.
 
Updated Swift Recoil as follows: When guarding an enemy attack with Swift Recoil, cooldown decreases by 3 seconds. When using Swift Recoil, the long press control is removed. However, the motion can still be used with the same long movement distance by pressing the directional keys at the same time.
 
Projectile hit radius is increased by 30% when enemies are nearby, making it easier to hit with Kradie Blast and Kradie Burst.Using a normal attack, after using Quick Slip or Slip Sliding, will now chain to a second normal attack.
 
[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes:

Letty is one of the characters in charge of Core Breakoff in a raid party, but recently (as the play time for battles has become shorter) there have been frequent instances where Letty cannot use Active: Firecracker twice. Therefore, we've added an additional effect of destroying weak points for Active: Letty Bomba.

 

We've also made it easier to destroy weak points with Active: Firecracker. We've increased the duration of the bomb and made it possible to enhance its stages with Standing Flip and Active: Beautiful Blaze, so that you can reliably force an explosion even in situations where you don't have time to use the Normal Attack x2 - Smash Combo or the Normal Attack x3 - Smash Combo.

 

Additionally, we have strengthened the damage compensation for close combat situations and corrected the issue where Swift Recoil would jump you far back and unintentionally increase the distance. Now you can fight while maintaining your desired distance.

The drain motion that follows use of the skills below is updated to be approximately 20% faster than before. Aerial Evasion and Handspring were previously structured so that the dodge zone would increase depending on the skill rank. This has been updated so that the dodge zone will be applied until the landing point, regardless of rank.
 
The cooldown applied when using Aerial Evasion, after defending against an enemy attack from the front, is adjusted from 10 seconds to 5.Adjusted the time during which you can block an enemy attack with Occluded Soul and then chain to Aerial Evasion or Handspring. Added relevant information to the skill description of Dark Charge.[table][tr][td]
Developer's Notes: 

The method of increasing the Shadow Ambush damage multiplier through Mortal Arts after using Grimden's Dark Charge skill was only applicable by successfully doing it within a limited action time of 1 second, and it was inconvenient because it did not show when the effect was active.

 

To improve this part, the Mortal Arts Enhanced status effect was added after Dark Charge to make it more intuitive, and the many action restrictions were changed so that the damage multiplier will increase even when performing other actions, as long as a successful Mortal Arts was performed through Shadow Ambush while the effect is active.

 

Additionally, the effect duration was buffed from 1 second to 3 seconds.

 

With this patch, we expect that it will be easier to successfully use Mortal Arts Shadow Ambush after the Dark Charge skill.

notes.title: Sanyaa: The Lost Outsider
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Vindictus team.

Today we're introducing the 25th hero of Vindictus, Sanyaa.

 

She is a female character who wields Dual Knives.

 

These are fast and precise weapons that target the weaknesses of her enemies and are a perfect match for her hand-to-hand skills. 

Utilizing combat resources that build up over the course of the fight, players will be able to experience dynamic gameplay.

As you dodge enemy attacks and successfully counterattack, certain moves become more powerful, and can turn the tide of battle in your favor.

She's a fun character to play, with quick attacks and deft dodges! 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1367/sanyaa1.jpg

(Sanyaa with Dual Knives)

 
Quickly dodge enemy attacks
Sanyaa is a character who specializes in dodging incoming attacks.

You have two basic dodges and can use Egret Step to quickly dodge in emergencies.

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1368/sanyaa2.jpg

(Sanyaa dodging enemy attacks)

 
Dodge and counterattack
Sanyaa can rapidly counter with a Shadow Reprisal if she times her dodge.

If you successfully counter with Shadow Reprisal, you'll be in a Playful state for a period of time.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1369/sanyaa3.jpg

(Counterattacking Sanyaa)

 
Playful
When Sanyaa is being Playful, her Heron Step skill is enhanced to Shadow Play to dance around her adversaries.  

In addition, her Swift Slash skill is enhanced to Play Rough, which can turn the tide of battle in your favor. 

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1370/sanyaa4.jpg

(Sanyaa attacking with Play Rough)

 
Sanyaa's quick approach and powerful skills
Sanyaa's Active: Thief's Mark allows her to mark her enemies.

After marking them, re-entering an active skill during its duration will allow Sanyaa to quickly approach and attack the marked target.

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1371/sanyaa5.jpg

(Sanyaa approaching the marked target)

 

"Active: Take Flight" is a skill that attacks enemies by spinning in midair.

From the moment you spin, you can change direction with the directional keys.

 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q3/1372/sanyaa6.jpg

 

Other moves include "Active: Vanishing Dance," which lets you disappear for a moment and then attack, "Active: Crescent Kick," and more.

She has a number of active skills that can be utilized in different combat situations.

 

That's Sanyaa, our upcoming 25th hero in Vindictus.

We'll always do our best to provide you with a fun and enjoyable experience.

As always, we thank you for supporting Vindictus!

notes.title: [CMTY] GM Coin S4: Sanyaapshot
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/fe46643fd67611cf24c006083c3e4b917c55cab3.jpg

Event Period: 8/12/2024 (Mon) after weekly maintenance - 9/24/2024 (Tue) before weekly maintenance

 

Mercenaries,

Now with Sanyaa here, there’s an important task we all must do first:

It’s to show her around the world of Vindictus!

 

Take her to your favorite places in Vindictus and take the best photo for her.

It’ll be a perfect gift, especially with the drawings we prepared last month..!

 
How to Participate:Visit a place in Vindictus that is special to you, and take a picture of SanyaaAlong with the photo, include a short description of why that place is special to you
 
Information Needed to Participate:ServerYour "Sanyaa" Character NameScreenshots of Sanyaa in your favorite placeOne line explaining why that place is special to you
 
Reward Information:If more than 70 screenshots are entered through our Discord event channel, then all players will receive 20 GM Coins during the 9/24/2024 (Tue) weekly maintenanceThe two best photos will receive an additional 10 GM Coins for their post, and we will post their photos on our official social accountsIf there are not enough participants, then only those who participated will receive a coupon code
 
Notes:The two best photos will be selected by our teamYou must participate in the event as the 'Sanyaa' characterYou may not participate multiple timesRewards will be issued during the 9/24/2024 maintenancePosts that don't follow the form, or are not relevant, will be considered invalidSome entries may be used in future social posts

notes.title: [UPDATE] Ver. 3.14 Update Note
notes.content:
Cairde System

 
You can see all the characters in your account at once with the new Cairde system.Complete the "About ID: Cairde" story to obtain the Cairde Name Change Coupon, available once per account.When the Cairde Name is changed, the previous name cannot be used again for 30 days.When changing the name with the Cairde Name Change Coupon, Cairde Names in the Send/Receive Friend Invite List will be applied upon logging in again.
 Cairde Names listed in the Marketplace when registering items, in the Guild Storage log, or as the Chat name before the Cairde Name change will not themselves be changed.
 
A "Cairde" menu is added to the Menu (T) UI.You can search Cairde Names through an exact Cairde Name match or a character name.Blocking a Cairde will block all characters in that Cairde at once.Cairde Block and existing character blocks will stack.
 
 You can check the characters, levels, login info, and guild names for each character in a Cairde you search for.If a player that you've blocked changes Cairde Names, then the Cairde shown on the UI for that character will change upon logging in again.Cairde Block's Cairde NameFriend > Block Setting's Cairde NameThe Cairde Name will be shown above the character's head.You can choose to show the Cairde Names of other players or yourself through the Show Cairde Name option in Options > ETC.The Cairde Name will be shown in chat.You may choose to show the Cairde Name in chat through the "Show Cairde Name" in chat options.You can also see the Cairde Name in the following categories:Cairde Name of the character registering an item to sell at the Marketplace.Cairde Name of the character making crafting requests at a Display Stand.Receive/Send Invites, and blocked characters', Cairde Name.Guild > Guild Members tab characters' Cairde Name.Cairde Name of the character in Guild Storage log.View Character Info.Character Intro during battle departure. Names listed in the Marketplace when registering items, and the Guild Storage log, before the Cairde system update will not show those Cairde Names.
 
You can kick guild members from a guild by their Cairde Name.Administrators and higher can kick all characters in the same Cairde from the guilld at once, through [Kick Cairde] in the Guild > Management tab.You cannot use the [Kick Cairde] option on the Guild Master's Cairde.You cannot use the [Kick Cairde] option for players who have a character with the same rank as you. (Administrators may not kick out other Administrators.)You cannot use the [Kick Cairde] option on your own Cairde.

notes.title: [UPDATE] The One Who Protects the Altar: Sreng
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.

The newest raid is called the "The One Who Protects the Altar."
You can depart for The One Who Protects the Altar from the Mount Celsina region of Toward Taratha.
 
 
The Eweca Legion assembles in an ancient temple at the mountain's summit, in order to hold a ritual to enable Balor's return.
Macha cunningly manipulates the situation to make the Eweca Legion clash with the alliance.
Meanwhile, the hero's party follows Seanna's visions towards the altar, but they run across a battle-hardened veteran.
This is none other than The One Who Protects the Altar: Sreng.
Sreng's honor as a soldier, and his loyalty to his god Balor, are further fueled by a burning need for revenge after losing his beloved Bres. 
Trying to focus, he moves to block the hero's progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/82a62897f773ceb44648f104b22063925200eebc.jpg



A giant from the otherworld, Sreng believes his body is the strongest weapon he could ever wield.
He fights with all of his heart, even after realizing the hero is far stronger than he first thought.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/48e3519b2a7fed3980e4ff3ceedee0996e74c9e9.jpg



Sreng is so strong that he can harness the power of earth to confine the heroes. Certain attacks reveal how he is consumed with rage.
It's impossible to defend against or dodge Sreng's violent attacks when you're so trapped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/42b87479c1cc8708b6f1dea4a2ed92860bf118c5.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/5a43c4a18e6f20561c20eeebe0d1a922fa9e0eac.jpg



When Sreng's eyes burn yellow, it is a sign that he will go berserk, so you must attack him with all your might.
An enraged Sreng has seemingly limitless power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/ad69206c30b3f7deef647f2e24de4cd8eec7304d.jpg



Demonstrating his supreme loyalty to Balor, Sreng sets himself on fire and faces off against the heroes
in order to protect the altar where the ritual is taking place.
Sreng's attacks while berserk add damage so greatly increased that it can't even be compared to what he was dealing previously.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/7d4f4d37ed014b6bf6bdfce1bbb200d2875b032d.jpg

 
 
The Season 4 Episode 9 raid, "The One Who Protects the Altar," will be live soon.
As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.
Thank you for your support of Vindictus!

notes.title: Pre-Announcement on Changes in June Level Cap Expansion Update
notes.content:
Announcement on Main Planned Changes, based on the June Level Cap Expansion Update

Hello!

We are making an announcement in advance regarding the June level cap expansion update, and planned changes to the existing content and system.

June Level Cap Expansion/Planned Changes Update Schedule: 6/25/2024 (Tue) during maintenance

Planned Changes for Content/System
* Some aspects may change depending on how things develop, so please check what's actually reflected on the day of the official server update.


Expertise
 You can obtain top expertise through stories that can be completed after increasing each expertise to 399.
- You can craft Lv. 115 weapons and armor into Lv. 120 weapons and armor using top expertise.
- You can craft Lv. 120 accessories using top goldsmithing expertise.
- You can craft certain outfit sets using top armorsmithing and tailoring expertise.
- A weapon recipe that can be crafted using top expertise will be added. (The added weapons can be used by applying the appearance to a brandish.)
 Equipment that cannot be crafted through your character's expertise can be crafted using the expertise shared from another character within your account. You may also request crafting from another player.


Supply Depot
 "Airtight Premium Armor Enhancement Runes" are no longer sold in the Supply Depot.


Exchange Shop

 You can no longer purchase Goibhniu's Enhancement Stones from the Seal of Bravery Exchange Shop.


NPC Crafting
 You can request Enhancement Runes, Premium Enhancement Runes, Premium Armor Enhancement Runes, Premium Enhancement Runes+, Goibhniu's Enhancement Stones, and Goibhniu's Enhancement Stones+ from NPC Brynn in Colhen.
- Like before, you can use the items when enhancing equipment below Lv. 115. They can also be used as required materials for advancing Lv. 120 items.


Temporal Missions and Weekly Rewards
 The mission content and rewards for daily, weekly, and monthly missions will change.
 A new "Temporal Mission," that's given according to a character's completion status of Raid Battles, will be added.
 A "Weekly Progress Reward," that can be obtained after completing a mission related to Raids, will be added.


System
 The "Core Boost System" will be added, while the "Deific Devotion" system will be retired.
 The "Raid Passport Extraction" system will be retired.


Battle
 The "Royal Army Total War" Battle will end.
 The required level for entry to Royal Army Battle will change from 60 to 115, and the minimum stat boost effect will be removed.
 The required level for entry to Red Moon's Energy Battle will change from 100 to 110.
 The required level for entry to Abyssal Arena 1 will change from 90 to 100.
 The required level for entry to Abyssal Arena 2 will change from 100 to 110.
 The required level for entry to Special Dungeon will change from 110 to 115.
* Along with the changes to required levels for battles, there will be changes made to Monster Stats, battle limit numbers, and obtainable loot.


Play Guide
 "Reach Lv. 110" Growth Goals will be added to the Play Guide.
 A new guide mission, based on the level cap expansion, will be applied.
- The existing guide mission will be reset during maintenance on the day of the level cap update.
- All statuses of existing missions, both in progress and completed, will be reset. Please make sure to accept any available rewards beforehand.


Rank 7 Enchant Scroll
 When a Rank 7 Enchant fails, the item will not be destroyed. (The item destruction penalty applies for items Rank 6 or higher.)
 When a Rank 7 Enchant fails, an Enchant Scroll Scrap cannot be obtained. (It can be obtained from Rank 6 or higher.)
- Even after the 6/25/2024 (Tue) update, four Rank 7 Enchant Scroll Scraps already in possession can be used to craft an Enchant Scroll.
 The icon color for a Rank 7 Enchant Scroll will change from orange to purple.

notes.title: [Letter from Allanon] Developer's Notes
notes.content:
Hello, this is DEV Allanon. 

I’d like to introduce everyone with the Developer’s Notes for May. 

 

[Battles] 

A New Raid will be added along with the Main Story. 

Sreng, the Adversary of all, Earth Legion Commander of the Eweca Forces appears as the boss monster blocking your path. 

He harbors a deep affection for Blood Legion Commander Bres, the Blood Mistress, intensifying his resentment towards your party. 

However, he’s not the foolish kind to neglect his duties of legion commander for revenge. 

A dreadful battle awaits, with Sreng willing to risk his life to fulfill his mission. 

 

We’re also preparing a total of 6 Royal Army Raid Battles: 

[Gates of Hell], [The Dark, Dank Sewers], [The Giant], [Into the Abyss], [Burning Temple], [The Evil One]. 

Every day, two different battles from the list will be chosen in rotation. 

Each battle requires Lv.115 to depart, and Minimum stat adjustments will no longer be available.  

Departure methods remain the same as before and you will be able to earn a new item that allows processing of Mysterious / Abyssal Shards, plus a newly added Mysterious Glass Bottle (Lv.60). 

The new Mysterious Glass Bottle (Lv.60) will not drop: Godly Iron Ore, Heavenly Leather, Heavenly Cloth, and Paradise Orb. 

 

We’re also preparing 9 Special Dungeons: 

(Special)[Avatar of Destruction], [Memory of the Past], [Remembrance], [Garden of Tears], [The Price of Failure], [Brilliant Lugh], [Fate and Destiny], [God of Death], [Dungeon Laboratory] 

Every week, three different battles from the list will be chosen in rotation, and each battle requires Lv.115 to depart. 

From the new Special Dungeons, you can earn Special Dungeon: Enchant Pouches. 

We do not have any plans for any new enchantments for now, but we are looking into adding them when new accessories or items are added. 

 

Meanwhile, the rewards for the [Dusk on Crescent Moon Island] have been renewed, and we’ve also reallocated rewards so that you can play existing raid battles depending on what item you wish to obtain. 

With the maximum level expansion, [Battle of Rocheste], [Clan of Darkness], [Spearhead of Paradise Lost], [Under the Pale Moon], [Ladaton Bridge], [Royal Castle Dungeon] will be adjusted to normal battles. 

Also, Waking Stones (Rank A) that were originally dropped from Royal Army Total War will now be added to the Redeemers rewards box obtained after the patch. 

 

[Expertise] 

A new Expertise rank, ‘Artisan’ will be added as a maximum level Expertise rank. This can be earned only after completing the story quest, ‘Advanced Expertise Artisan.’ 

If you obtain the Artisan rank for Expertise, you can craft or advance(Name TBD) Lv.120 items and can also receive crafting requests. 

A crafting request requires the requester to prepare all the materials, and the Artisan can proceed using a stall placed in town. 

You can only have one Artisan rank Expertise per character, but other characters’ Expertise can be shared. 

Shared Expertise of the sort can still craft items, but it won’t let you place stalls or receive requests. 

 

You can also Transfer your Expertise. 

You can only transfer Expertise below 399, before you earn the title of Artisan. When you transfer your Expertise, all the titles you own related to it moves along with it. 

We considered transferring only the expertise proficiency while retaining the titles. 

However, we're concerned that the transferred character won't be able to acquire titles and that using the transfer system would become mandatory for title retention, leading to a complex situation. Therefore, we've decided to proceed in this manner. 

Some Artisan rank Expertise will allow crafting avatar from previous equipment, and the necessary materials can be earned from Niflheim and Special Dungeons. 

 

[Crafting or advancing Lv.120 items] 

As said earlier, you will be able to craft Lv.120 items through Artisan rank Expertise. 

A +15 Orna equipment with all stats except the ATT surplus tuned will be used as crafting material, and the crafted item’s exchangeability will follow the material item’s exchange type. 

Also, if you use an extraction rune during crafting, you can also create an item that copies the exact same enchantments from the material item. 

These crafted items start from Normal, and you can advance(Name TBD) them through Beginner – Fine – Superior – Rare – Legendary. 

 

To utilize advancements(Name TBD), you need an item called Advance Stone(Name TBD). You can craft them if you have Artisan rank Expertise. 

To craft, you need Essence: Fragments and Inherited Power: Fragements, along with Goibhniu’s Stone, Goibhniu’s Stone+, Superior Enhancement Elixir, etc. 

With this crafted Advance Stone(Name TBD) and some special materials, Jardin Steels, Premium Runes, Premium Runes+, Premium Armor Enhancement Runes, etc. As materials, you can advance (Name TBD) your item. 

 

[Core Boost] 

The Core Boost system will be divided into two groups: Raid Battles and others, with the other group including Special Dungeons, Niflheim, Royal Army and Abyssal Arena. 

Core Boost effects apply to 10 Raid Battles and 6 other battles daily, and you can apply Core Boost effects to the desired battle. 

It can be used on a character basis, and when exceeding the number of battles, Core Boost effects will no longer apply. 

  

When Core Boost effects are applied, you can obtain Core Boost-exclusive items and have a double chance of obtaining major reward. 

Previously, the Core Boost system was planned to provide more rewards and gold, but to ensure a smoother gameplay experience, it has been changed to double the chance of obtaining major rewards only. 

With the application of the Core Boost system, changes in the pattern of playing Battle Circuit are expected, and the groups for Battle Circuit will be further subdivided accordingly. 

Please note that Core Boost effects are not applied in Solo Mode. 

 

[Others] 

Daily, Weekly, Monthly missions will be renewed. 

Especially the daily and weekly missions, which originally simply repeated the same missions, will now grant different missions regarding your character’s raid clear status. 

Also, we’ve managed to remove some missions that were unfair, and adjusted the rewards so that they’re more worthwhile. 

Sub Character Boosts and the Mercenary Blessing will now be expanded to Lv.115 as well. 

There’re still many minor changes, such as Eweca’s Blessing expanded to Lv.104, that I can’t mention in the Developer Notes. Please keep an eye out for the details in the coming updates. 

 

We will keep striving in both development and communication. 

Thank you.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Ver. 3.11 Update
notes.content:
Table of Contents
[olist]
 Character Balance Adjustment
 Reverent Tower
 Equipment Share
 Friendship System
 Emotes
 Characters
 Items
 UI
[/olist]

1. Character Balance Adjustment
 Developers’ Notes:

For this patch, our development focus was on balancing the overall DPS before the July character utilities patch.

We will continue to keep an eye on DPS balance, and we plan to focus on emphasizing each character's unique qualities, branching out from utility improvements. 

Lann - Twin Swords

 Adjusted Fury Type Skills Damage Increase Rate from 20% to 15% for "Furious" Status Effect.


Lann - Twin Spears

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 5%:
- Moon Splitter
- Grand Hurricane
 Added new status effect "Vulnerable":
- When receiving an attack from an enemy while using the "Moon Splitter" or "Grand Hurricane" attacks, Lann gains the "Vulnerable" status effect.
- DEF decreases for 3 seconds, and the status effect stacks up to 3 stages.
- The Vulnerable status effect is applied in the following way:

[table]			[tr]			[td]Phase 1[/td]			[td]Phase 2[/td]			[td]Phase 3[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]DEF -3%[/td]			[td]DEF -8%[/td]			[td]DEF -15%[/td]		[/tr]	[/table] 
 Developers’ Notes:

Twin Swords Lann is showing a high, even level of DPS in most battles. 

To emphasize Lann's Twin Swords combat qualities, we added evasive frames to Gliding Fury during the March balance patch, and we adjusted the Furious status Damage Increase Rate for DPS balance.

When Lann uses Twin Spears, he shows a relatively low level of DPS in Hero+ and Space Time Distortion Battles, but he has a some of the highest levels of DPS in Normal Battles, so there is a big disparity that's noticeable.

We believe that the reason he has high efficiency in Normal Battles is through the use of restoration potions, and the so-called "hit exchange" form of gameplay that mainly occurs.

Although one might think Twin Spear Lann looks best when he uses explosive attacks like Moon Splitter and Grand Hurricane, we think that there needs to be appropriate risk in hit exchange gameplay.

Therefore, we increased the damage of these two skills to emphasize their qualities, but we were inclined to add the Vulnerable status effect for excessive hit exchange tactics.

Fiona - Longsword

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 5%:
- "Amaranth Kick"
- "Amaranth Kick" (additional attack)
- "Ivy Sweep"
 Decreased the damage of the following attack by 15%:
- "Counterattack" while using "Active: Shield Enhancement"
 Developers’ Notes:

Longsword Fiona is showing the highest levels of DPS in Hero+ and Space Time Distortion Battles.

However, she shows relatively low levels of DPS in Normal Battles, so there is a big disparity between various difficulties.

So, we have decreased the amount of damage that's been concentrated on counter attacks, and we increased the damage for Amaranth Kick, which is also useful in Normal Battles, in order to remedy these imbalances.

Kai - Bow

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 3%:
- "Normal Attack" (Longbow)
- "Fixed Shot"
- "Level 1 Magnum"
- "Level 2 Magnum"
- "Level 3 Magnum"
- "Active: Ricochet Shot" (Longbow)

Kai - Cross Gun

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 10%:
- "Active: Perforate"
- "Active: Perforate" (when "Active: Enhanced Bolt" is in use)
- Increased the damage of the following attacks by 5%:
- "Active: Hollow Shot"
- "Active: Hollow Shot" (when "Active: Enhanced Bolt" is in use)
- "Active: Hollow Shot" (additional attack)
- "Active: Six Shooter" detonation attack
- "Active: Six Shooter" detonation attack (when "Active: Enhanced Bolt" is in use)
- "Active: Bolt Storm"
- "Active: Massive Impact"

 Developers’ Notes:

Kai generally shows a low level of DPS in most battles.

Kai is one of the hardest characters to balance as there is a big disparity between players who are good at using Kai and those who are not. To adjust the balance, we increased Kai's damage by a large amount, especially when he uses the Cross Gun.

We are looking at the brilliant ideas for improvements to him that our players are suggesting, and we will sort through them during the utilities improvement later to find a good development direction that emphasizes his good qualities and improves those aspects that are lacking.

Delia

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 5%:
- "Rising Comet"
- "Falling Comet"

 Developers’ Notes:

We believe the core of Delia's combat style revolves around her comet attacks.

In the March balance patch, we added Full Moon evasive frames, but rather than the goal being to emphasize Delia's qualities as a character, this was to improve her survivability which was lacking, and to allow for flexible reactions when battling monsters.

In the recent stats Delia is still showing low levels of DPS overall, so first we increased the power of comet-style attacks. Afterwards we will look into emphasizing the unique qualities of comet attacks when revamping Vigor, Zenith, and the like as we mentioned previously.

Miri

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 10%:
- "Active: Blazing Spine"
- Shock Wave that uses "Wyvern Magic" Status Effect
 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 3%:
- "Fiery Chainswing"

 Developers’ Notes:

For Miri's character the cooldown for Ancestral Garb has been decreased. We were aiming for direct increases related to that and a better gameplay experience overall. However, we discovered that she still tended to have relatively low levels of DPS, so we ended up increasing the damage for certain attacks.

Latiya

 Decreased the damage of the following attacks by 8%:
- "Rhino Rush"
 Decreased the damage of the following attacks by 3%:
- "Eagle Stab"


For more details, please click HERE!

Lann - Common

[quote=] Developer's Notes: 
The intent of adding evasive frames to Gliding Fury was to retain Lann's bold and lighthearted playstyle.
However, we recognize that excessive overbalance can make your gameplay less tense, so we'll be adjusting Gliding Fury's evasion to a level that allows him to respond to monster attacks. 
We'll also be monitoring Twin Swords Lann closely as he's expected to generate a significant damage boost, which may unfortunately result in a nerf in April's character balance. 
We also promise to continue to monitor Twin Spears Lann to ensure that he maintains an appropriate difficulty level in that combat experience. 

Arisha - Spellsword

 Increased the damage of the following attacks by 10%:
> Active: Crystal Burst

Active: Crystal Burst's STA recovery amount is increased.
> When inflicting damage on the enemy by detonating the Mana Crystal: 100 → 120

 Active: Ether Zone's STA recovery amount is increased.
> When inflicting damage on the enemy by detonating the Mana Crystal: 100 → 120
> Each time you inflict damage on the enemy in the damaging mana zone area: 13 → 20


Delia

 Can now briefly dodge enemy attacks with the final attack of 'Active: Full Moon'.
> The final spin animation of the active skill, Full Moon,

 The Full Moon that chains from Guard can now dodge enemy attacks.

 Changed the 'Vigor' Status Effect as below.
> The damage increase rate applied on the enemy via Comet skills has been adjusted when Vigor Lv. 1 and Lv. 2 are applied.
- Lv. 1: 10% → 15%
- Lv. 2: 15% → 18%
- Lv. 3: 20% (Same)

>  Changed the hit conditions that reduce the 'Vigor' effect's level.
- Lv. 1: Hit 7x → 8x
- Lv. 2: Hit 5x → 6x
- Lv. 3: Hit 3x → 4x

 To further elaborate, we are providing the frames for the action on the chart below.
  * Full Moon Evasive Frame Changes
[table]			[tr]			[td]　[/td]			[td]Evasive Frame[/td]			[td]Gravity Hop Combo[/td]			[td]Eclipse Combo[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Previous[/td]			[td]N/A[/td]			[td]After 55 frames[/td]			[td]After 55 frames[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]Modified[/td]			[td]0 - 45 frames[/td]			[td]After 40 frames[/td]			[td]After 55 frames[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]

[quote=] Developer's Notes: 
We're expecting the evasive properties added to Full Moon after Delia's Guard to give her more flexibility in how the she can react to monsters.
We don't expect this to translate directly to improved character performance (although it should make for better combat and survival).
We'll keep an eye on the play logs so that we can make adjustments in the March character balance.
Also, the Keen effect added to the Ion Thrust seemed to be of marginal benefit so we did not apply a fix.
We will re-evaluate it around the time we implement utility improvements along with Vigor, Zenith, etc. 

Miri

 Changed Active: Ancestral Garb as below.
- Required SP: 500 → 300
- Cooldown: 520 sec

 'Active: Ancestral Garb' animation can now be skipped via dodging.
- You can now use Dodge to skip the animation in both solo and multi-player battles.

[quote=] Developer's Notes: 
We're keeping the same usage patterns as the original ultimate format, but reducing the cooldown to make it more useful in longer battles such as Redeemers and Space Time Distortion.
Miri's performance required some buffs, so we felt the decision to leave the cooldowns alone would not overpower her.
We'll keep an eye on the character's performance over time to see if she should be included in the April character balance.
We're also testing the selective use of the transformation appearance that Miri players have been wanting, so we can promise that will be in the April update.

Charon

 'Star Fall' can now be chained off the skills below.
- Arisha (Spellsword) - Active: Temporal Shift
- Arisha (Spellwhip) - Active: Chaos Symphony
- Vella (Twin Swords) - Active: Cyclone

Kai

 'Prey Drive' can now be chained off the skills below.
- Arisha (Spellsword) - Active: Temporal Shift
- Arisha (Spellwhip) - Active: Chaos Symphony
- Vella (Twin Swords) - Active: Cyclone

Arisha - Spellwhip

 Increased Active: Chaos Symphony's stun duration on the enemy monster by 1 second.

Vella - Twin Swords

 Increased Active: Cyclone's stun duration on the enemy monster by 1 second.

[quote=] Developer's Notes: 
As part of the modifications to Charon and Kai's skills above, we've added a 1 second stun for Arisha (Spellwhip) and Vella (Twin Swords) to prevent monsters from attacking them when they're using their suppression moves.
We've retained the duration of the time you are unable to control your character while the characters are using the suppression moves.
The issue where you are unable to combo after Hurk's Active: Terminus and Evie's Active: Reverse Gravity are currently put on hold as there are additional things we need to verify.
There's a problem where using Hurk's Active: Terminus and entering an additional input could extend the animation, creating buggy gameplay that disables combos.
We'll first need to decide on which direction we want to go with the fix.
Also, Evie's Active: Reverse Gravity is not set as her main suppression move so the fix has been delayed.

notes.title: "Special Stern Patrician Top" Dye Part Change Pre-Notice
notes.content:
Some dye parts of the Special Stern Patrician Top will be changed during the Tuesday maintenance on 3/26/2024.

 The coat lining's color that was influenced by 'Color Part 3' will be changed to be affected by 'Color Part 2' instead.
 Due to this change, the Special Stern Patrician Top's Color Parts 2 and 3 will revert to outfit's default dye colors.


If you had used an Outfit Dye Ampoule to apply different colors to Color Parts 2 and/or 3 before the maintenance, we will send an appropriate Experimental Outfit Dye Ampoule to your character's mailbox.

If an outfit cloned via Clone Outfit Crafting Box currently exists as an attached item in the mailbox, the outfit icon will display the colors from before the change. However, after claiming the outfit you will see it in the updated colors.

notes.title: [CMTY] [Letter from Allanon] Expertise Update (Intention and Changes)
notes.content:
Hello, This is DEV Allanon.

The Vindictus Team has received extensive feedback from our users regarding the Max Level Expansion and Expertise Update.

Thoroughly reviewing the feedback provided an opportunity to assess whether the planned update is on the right track.

Before delving into the details, it's necessary to explain the intention behind the Expertise update.

Additionally, I would like to address the changes we’ve made based on the feedback from our users.


[INTENTION FOR EXPERTISE UPDATE]

The intention for the expertise update can be elaborated in three main aspects:

1. We aim to make the circulation of materials more fluent by expanding the usage of expertise and farming processes.

As valuable materials are concentrated in top-tier battles, we intend to adjust the value of lower-tier battles through the update.

We expect to create a more enriching gaming environment by providing motivation to users enjoying top-tier battles and inducing play patterns such as targeting specific battles for needed items.

We're also considering developing a feature that allows players to selectively remove the crafter's name, as previously discussed.


2. We are planning to gradually change the gameplay pattern to reduce play fatigue and require less playtime.
In line with recent gaming trends, we want our users to enjoy Vindictus with a lighter heart than before.

To achieve this, we plan to change and adjust the playtime structure more efficiently, resulting in better outcomes.

We anticipate that the ‘Core Boost System’ will lead the intended changes, with increased synergy expected from this system in line with the first intention mentioned.

Additionally, for players who prefer longer playtimes, we felt it necessary to adjust the advantages of playing sub-characters.


3. With the diminishing importance of communication, we intend to activate more interaction between users through Expertise.

As an online game, playing with others is unavoidable.

However, due to recent declines in competition and cooperation, there is a concern that interacting with one another may seem awkward in Vindictus.

While the expertise update may not be the perfect solution, we hope it will serve as a stepping stone for positive change.


[MODIFICATION FOR PLANNED EXPERTISE UPDATE]

Firstly, top-tier expertise will remain shareable across accounts.

Crafting will also be possible with shared top-tier expertise.

This means a single character will be able to use all top-tier expertise and engrave the same crafter's name on items.

Also we are planning to develop an function to delete the crafter name as well.

Secondly, material refinement needed for crafting will be possible through both expertise crafting and NPC crafting.


Thirdly, we plan to introduce an expertise transfer system for players currently investing time and effort into upgrading expertise proficiency.

Transfer between characters meeting certain requirements such as level will be possible.

During the transfer, the title related to the expertise will also be transferred.

However, top-tier expertise will not be transferable, and only expertise proficiency up to 399 will be eligible for transfer.


In summary, regarding the update to top-tier expertise following the max level expansion, a single character will not be allowed to learn all top-tier expertise, but sharing will be permitted between characters within the same account.

However, shared expertise will only be allowed to craft equipment for its own use, and crafting for other characters will be precluded.


We understand that the change itself may not be discomforting for our Mercenaries.

However, we recognize the need for corrections if the change results in significant profit or loss depending on the situation.

We are sincerely grateful for the feedback provided by the Mercenaries.

Some Mercenaries may agree with the above intentions, while others may not.

We understand that these concerns stem from a love for the game Vindictus.

Therefore, both myself and all members of the Vindictus team will do our best to proceed with the update with great care.


Thank you.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Sidhe Palace: Bres
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team. 

Today we would like to introduce our new raid, "Sidhe Palace." 
You can depart for Sidhe Palace in Toward Taratha, through the Sen Mag Forest region. 

The hero's party explores deeper into those woods following Seanna, who experienced a prophetic vision. 
As they emerge the party discovers Sidhe Palace, the resting place of an incarcerated king who spent the final years of his life alone. 
Entering a garden full of red roses, the hero encounters the new master of this previously abandoned palace. 
Bres is the commander of a vampire army... and revels in sadistic slaughter. 
With powerful attacks harnessing blood, Bres intends to force the party into a desperate situation. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/ca0685665420989f80adb326f535afcf5e6b5923.jpg


Bres brandishes a long, thin sword and threatens the hero with beautiful, elegant movements. 

After underestimating the strength of these interlopers, Bres conducts a symphony of bloodshed. She shows her true colors as the battle grows fiercer. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/6bb954779282d9524ebcfd67207f1865d0e385d8.jpg


At the midway point of the battle, Bres uses her own blood to make even more powerful attacks. 
If hit by these and "Excessive Bleeding" is triggered, you take damage over time for a set duration, and enter into exhaustion more rapidly. 
However, if Bres fails to connect with multiple blood attacks, her stance will temporarily falter due to shedding too much of her own blood. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/aced76b810c4ae89f59cab0dbe95135cced8d663.jpg
 

Bres is also capable of absorbing blood from the roses blooming in her garden, and when she absorbs enough, she makes a very powerful attack that covers the entire area. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/be1170a3e15a6480a5caab4066d831abbed9f837.jpg


Be careful when her eyes start glowing in the middle of the battle. 
When hit by Bres's red orbs, all of your HP will be absorbed, and you will be incapacitated. These must be dodged or blocked.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/dcb2148c562f24f3e39985a46f286e327848b007.jpg


The Season 4 Episode 8 raid, Sidhe Palace, will be live soon. 
As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience. 
Thank you for your support of Vindictus!

 Developer's Notes: 
We've nerfed the health of the boss monsters in the above battles (which are the first party-recommended raids you'll experience as you level up) because we feel they're a bit too difficult.

We considered reducing boss damage directly or adjusting some of the more difficult patterns, such as instant kills, but we were concerned that these battles would lose their risk and thrill, when they are still being enjoyed by players who are already familiar with the combat. 

So, we've adjusted the DEF effect of Goddess's Guidance for players who are not yet familiar with each encounter, to make it a little easier for them to adjust to the party recommended raids. We'll continue to monitor the difficulty of these battles for new players to ensure that they're at an appropriate level.

- (All Characters - Common) Mastery skills, Meditation, Fishing

- (Evie) Alchemy: Mercury Trap
- (Karok) Boss Bash 
* Eligible Items: Pure Skill Reset Capsule, Skill Reset Capsule, High-Capacity Skill Reset Capsule 

 Developer's Notes: 
We've reviewed comments of those who want to revert some skills to the state before training it, so we are expanding the Skill Reset/Reset Capsule functions.


5. Misc. 

 Attempting to Depart (Solo) with a character below max level, to a party recommended battle, will now display the guide message that recommends party play.

 Developer's Notes: 
We've added a reminder message to prevent players who are new to the game from accidentally starting a solo run on Normal difficulty when they first see a party-recommended encounter.

This notification will only appear for characters who are not at max level, and it will not appear if you select Solo Mode. 

 Fixed the issue where ending the battle, returning to Colhen, then entering a building would play the background music. 
 Modified the internal operation of the channel server.

notes.title: [UPDATE] 24th New Hero: Sou
notes.content:
Hello, this is Vindictus. 


We introduce you to the 24th hero of Vindictus, Sou. 

Sou is a male character that uses the Oriental Blades, which consist of the Kodachi and Odachi. 

The Oriental Blades are a pair of weapons Sou learned to use as a guard in the Heaven's Palace of Geongon. 

Depending on the combat situation, Sou is able to use the Kodachi for quick and nimble strikes, or the Odachi for devastating attacks that cover a large area. 

Combining these two with Sou's unique sword technique, Shattered Sky, demonstrates versatile combat techniques across the battlefield. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/31f55206a70d5e5f26f09a666f15fb6da6d179e2.jpg
(Sou using the Oriental Blades) 


 Fluid Swordsmanship Using the Kodachi 
 Sou's swordplay while using the Kodachi consists of quick, consecutive attacks. 

He can parry the enemy attack, and successfully defending allows him to continue his previous chain of attacks. 

However, failing the parry prevents Sou from continuing this chain. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/48952eb4392021ca4ae098f445066ad2333c17bd.jpg
(Sou defending the enemy attack by parrying) 


 Unique Swordsmanship 
 Sou's signature technique, Shattered Sky, is the standby position that allows you to select between the Kodachi and Odachi to attack. 

Once he is in the Shattered Sky stance, he can respond to the enemy's attack. Successfully responding allows this wanderer to unleash "Shattered Sky: Vagabond Dance". 

The window of Vagabond Dance's availability is very small, so one should be aware of it during gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/f70da4bd6941d9aa0123ac3ebb062872dcb29547.jpg
(Sou in his Shattered Sky stance) 


 Shattered Sky: Flickering Edge or Shattered Sky: Cloudbreak 
 Shattered Sky: Flickering Edge quickly draws the Kodachi while in the Shattered Sky stance, inflicting additional damage and restoring stamina upon a successful hit. 

On the other hand, Shattered Sky: Cloudbreak attacks a large area with his Odachi. 

If he gathers the strength to swing, it creates the Blade Storm that inflicts additional damage. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/2338d36db388a5d9c225d18955e458bc90145498.jpg
(Sou using Shattered Sky: Flickering Edge) 


 Two Swords, Two Types of Active Skills 
 Sou's active skills change depending on which sword he is wielding. 

Using Distant Horizon with the Kodachi, he sheaths his sword and quickly draws it and slashes twice. 

Using it with the Odachi, however, will perform a slower but more powerful downward strike. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/a25e4d14fbd71273233e3d33ad2ced411452beae.jpg
(Sou using Distant Horizon with the Kodachi) 


Soaring Dragon slashes the enemy up with the Odachi, then strikes down with the Kodachi while spinning. 

Using it while wielding the Odachi will slash once more on the ground as he soars up. 

You can use the directional keys while spinning down to track the enemy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/68c32f52c1511c66b3be2ef03d3736fa1d192ce1.jpg
(Sou using Soaring Dragon) 


In addition, Sou's active skills are versatile. Rise of Rebellions quickly slashes the enemy with light, cloud-like steps while Road to Ruin evades an enemy's attack as he strikes. 


Sou is the 24th hero of Vindictus, who will be revealed soon in the game update. 

We'll always do our best to provide you with a fun and enjoyable experience. 


As always, we thank you for supporting Vindictus!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Grave of Swords: Jarnir
notes.content:
Hello! This is the Vindictus team.

Today we would like to introduce our new raid, the "Grave of Swords."
You can depart for the Grave of Swords in Toward Taratha at the Dimensional Rift region.
 
"Jarnir," a warrior of the Meteorite Tribe, awaits you at an intimidating site where the swords of slain challengers stand like tombstones.
She has been following an old tradition of her tribe by battling numerous contenders.  
It is no wonder that this grim arena came to be known as the Grave of Swords.
As time went on, Jarnir desired ever more powerful opponents. Now our heroes are invited to test their bravery in battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/96474562ccfbe0d2802b09e83379a7e57d0fc36e.jpg


She uses two greatswords and five throwing spears to dominate the field.
Her swords may be slow, but each individual strike is devastating. Even a single mistake can cost you your life.
She looted her first greatsword from a past contender. She now uses it to measure the strength and skill of her opponent. 
Most challengers don't survive long enough to see her second sword.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/f54f693b9188eb3c667eee359adcbf145dfae0b3.jpg


Her second sword is a treasure of the Meteorite Tribe. It is attached to a lodestone that possesses extremely powerful magnetism.
Jarnir will only wield this honored weapon against true opponents that she acknowledges as worthy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/39c759ef30a5c1a3e52649b84cdaf9b45074ce77.jpg


When opponents try to get some distance, she attacks them with a throwing spear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/8396e5c201bafc2e561f064d2c26a0f38194ca60.jpg


When the magnetism is amplified to its extreme limit, the grave marker swords around the arena will be pulled to the greatsword, forming an even larger weapon.  
Even one strike from this grand greatsword is deadly, so one must focus on evading or blocking it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/dbff50acbaca0f40634ef9bd9399af5bae1eb01c.jpg

 
This new raid, Grave of Swords, will be introduced soon.
As always, we will do our best to provide you with a great gaming experience.
Thank you for your continued love and support for Vindictus!

notes.title: [INTRO] Achel
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/6c803e857810a71e67a470c62592943ce21bcded.jpg

[ABOUT]

Achel, a boy from the slums of fallen Connacht, has a fateful encounter with a foreign priestess, Sophia. 

Through her, he is finally able to dream of a better life, a paradise far removed from the harsh reality he's forced to endure for now. 

Soon, however, a cruel twist of fate will make that all come crashing down...  


[SCREENSHOTS]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/0e155192ab8b7821221979fa14c78c7ddab2e7b2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/dd774116403dbacde8075d7a1dc2dde4ecdfdeba.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/9a3dbf359b38a38bda442dcafcb17c3fe28d8d97.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/ab0ac11bc62bfffe2dce843dc8b82e31be1e9d07.jpg

[CLICK for the GAMEPLAY TRAILER]


[EXCLUSIVE SKILLS]
Click the skill name to check Achel's Exclusive Skills.

> Storm of Steel
- Performs consecutive stabbing and slashing attacks with the Hasta.
- Can leap a short distance, at a desired moment, to dodge enemy attacks while inflicting great damage across an area.

> Roots of Antaeus
- Stomps his foot, unleashing an "Adrenaline Spike."
- While he is burning through his adrenaline he is not easily exhausted, and he can perform devastating spear attacks. 
- He can also spend all of his Adrenaline Spike to combo into "Wild Swing," a slashing attack that instantly rushes at an enemy.

> Downfall
- Quickly charges towards an enemy, leaping up high and striking down like lightning.
- As the Hasta pierces the ground a powerful explosion occurs across the surface, applying a short stun effect.

> Total Destruction
- Achel's suppression skill.
- A powerful stab suppresses his foe, followed by a ruthless combination of spear and shield attacks that pummel them without mercy.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Welcome Starlight Knight Latiya
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/03a7d8ec398abb6c65a685900ea6312d2c96dc6b.png

Background Story of Latiya 

Latiya grew up in the dangerous jungles of the southern continent, trained to be the world's greatest hunter. Yet she was always obsessed with knights jousting on horseback, and dreamed of becoming one someday.

From her tribe she has gained the Kuja, a magical chain hook that she can summon from her hand. This allows her to quickly navigate the environment, to both elude and chase down prey. She pairs this with a lance, and while unorthodox, this creates powerful combos that only Latiya can perform.

She left the jungle and spent much time in her pursuit of the knighthood, training and competing in the popular jousting tournaments around the kingdom of Delshire. She met those who would come to care for her, and help in her quest. Unfortunately, this ended in mystery and tragedy that the player can investigate over time.

In the present, Latiya appears to have partially made peace with those lost days. She now seeks to live by the ideals of a knight, saving others, even if she did not truly earn the title. She wishes to be as starlight, which her tribe uses to guide others to safety.

She arrives in Colhen after rescuing a string of people, though her magic has grown so powerful that she accidentally destroys the surrounding environment whenever she does. The villagers do not quite know what to think of the young woman who seems so stalwart at some times, but so heartbroken at others.

CLICK HERE to see more of Latiya!

notes.title: [Updates] Kael Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/4f70a0d6ac3ec66d8046309f5f7bf0b81ea85a01.jpg

One Who Fights for Justice
Kael, born to a renowned family and following his duties as a knight of the royal guard, witnesses a sight that shatters his core beliefs from their very foundation.
Now questioning the privileged lifestyle of the nobility, he joins a commoners' resistance to fight for wellbeing of all.
However, a clash between the opposing forces leaves him with no choice but to find another way to mete out justice, and so he comes to Colhen.

[previewyoutube=1VxceKAvHUU;full][/previewyoutube]
Kael maximizes his weapon's length through both pointed stabs and wide-range slashes.
He can even inflict post-multi-hit wounds upon his enemies following key strikes.
Should he see success, he can then block oncoming attacks and follow up with a devastating counter.
His disciplined yet relentless assault through myriad multi-hit attacks and practiced parries makes him a balanced fighter no matter the challenge.

CLICK HERE to learn more about Kael!

notes.title: [Updates] v.2.67 Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/83fa7ed5ebd11e6aedfd17046140fa83c24a74e6.jpg

■ Guild House Update
The Guild House now has a function in its minimap to allows you to quickly move to a specified location.

You can use the cooking expertise in the Guild House's 1st and 2nd floor kitchens.
  - You can purchase Guild Feast ingredients at the Guild Shop.

Some functions of the Guild Farm have been improved.
  - For characters who are in a guild, up to 5 watering cans will be automatically replenished every day at 7AM UTC.
  - The automatically replenished watering cans are intangible items that can water the crops immediately when in possession.
  - The [Guild] Watering Can Kit will no longer be sold at the Guild Shop. Any watering cans and [Guild] Watering Can Kits in your possession will be deleted from your inventory. Every [Guild] Watering Can Kit will be replaced with 2 Guild Seals.
  - Expired [Guild] Watering Can Kits will not be replaced with Guild Seals.
  - Planted crops will no longer be replaceable if the crop has any remaining HP.

You can obtain 1 extra Guild Seal by using a watering can at the Guild Farm.

The reset times for the Guild House facilities listed below will change.
  - Seal Vending Machine > Can be used 3 times each day and is reset at 7AM UTC.
  - Daily Fortune Vending Machine > Can be used 1 time each day and is reset at 7AM UTC.
  - Bed Fatigue Point Recovery > Can be used 1 time each day and is reset at 7AM UTC.

When the Guild Feast is being prepared, system messages will continue to provide guidance in the guild chat even if system messages have been set to OFF.

A clock will appear at the top right of the Guild House screen.
  - Will display if [Menu (Shortcut Key (T)] > [Options] > [UI Settings] Tab > Display Clock is checked.

Major facilities not being displayed on the Guild House minimap has been fixed.

The problem of interactions not occurring correctly when approaching the side of the bed inside the Guild House's 2nd floor bedroom has been fixed.

The farm status within the Guild window, when outside of the Guild Farm, can now be closed using the [ESC] key.

Fixed the issue of guild info appearing incorrectly when using [Quick Character Change] after recovering Fatigue Points on the bed.
CLICK HERE for more details to the Patch Notes!

notes.title: [Update] Lethor Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/9ad7d18ca340e3227ef54409fc6a28fdb5e101ea.jpg

1. Lethor : Character Introduction

Putting her sorrows behind her, Lethor walks her path for her clan's last mission.

Lethor was born as a member of the Auroran Servants, a clan that has the power to manipulate aura.
One day, tragedy strikes, and the majority of its members--including Lethor's parents--are lost. This prompts the young girl to focus solely on studying the gift of her clan for years.

Time passes, and while on a mission, tragedy strikes once more. Her best friend and the remaining members of her clan are gone in an instant, leaving her alone.
Rather than drown in regrets, however, she steels herself and makes her way to the site of the last mission she had been given as an Auroran Servant: Colhen.

Lethor's talent in the martial arts is enhanced by her ability to manipulate aura.
Depending on the situation, she can perform a barrage of attacks or attempt a counter after blocking an enemy's strike.

We hope you enjoy Lethor's masterful martial arts and the way she chains her punches into torrent of pain or unleashes kicks with sledgehammer might.

[previewyoutube=bsLAAJ4T5pY;full][/previewyoutube]
CLICK HERE for more Lethor!

notes.title: [Update] Character Friendship System
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/25b1850d73d73836317d9009217abbf3a521f9a5.jpg
Friendship System The [Mercenary Lounge] has been added to the Mercenary Outpost in Colhen.
  - You can find allies of the Mercenary Unit resting inside the Mercenary Lounge.
  - Between 5 and 6 allies will visit the lounge each day.
  - If you don't find the ally you're looking for in the lounge, you can summon them by speaking with [Captain Crimson].
 
 A [Closeness] meter has been added.
  - A "Closeness" meter has been added that indicates your current relationship with each ally.
  - Note that you won't become best friends in a single day. If you bother your ally to much, they may need time to cool off. It's best to build up your friendships a little bit each day.
  - Also, keep in mind that if you go a long time without seeing your ally, your relationship may begin to sour.
  - You can increase Closeness by using [Talk], [Depart for Mission], and [Gift].
  - You can check the Closeness status of each ally using the [Closeness Status] button in the Character Window / All Menu and the [Manage Relationship] window in the lounge.
 
 Talking to the allies in the lounge.
  - You can approach an ally of your choice and strike up a conversation.
  - Interact with allies using the [Talk] function and talk to them about [Conversation Topics]. You can infer how close they feel to you by their responses.
  - As you talk to various allies, you can collect special [Conversation Topics]. You can find the [Conversation Topics] you've collected in the All Menu and the [Manage Topics] tab of the [Manage Relationship] window in the lounge. Different allies offer will react differently to the same conversation topics.
  - Use the [Gift] function to give gifts to your allies and raise their Closeness. You can purchase these gifts from the Gift Shop.
  - Increasing your Closeness with allies unlocks unique stories and conversations.
 
 You can now embark on Missions from the Mercenary Lounge
  - Battle alongside your allies in a new Mission system!
  - Allies automatically fight by your side without instruction, but you can issue certain commands using shortcut keys.
  - You can take on missions from the Mission Board in the lounge with the ally of your choice.
  - There are four types of missions: Border Patrol, Recon Run, Supply Circuit, and Support Mission.
  - Participating in missions grants rewards such as Closeness, EXP, and [Friendship Seals].
  - Victory and failure conditions vary by mission category.
  - Succeeding in missions grants greater rewards
  - If your ally's health is depleted, they will be exhausted for a time and will not respond to commands.
  - Allies will also become exhausted after performing certain powerful attacks.
  - The more time you spend with an ally, the stronger that ally becomes.
  - Damage you take from enemies and damage you deal to enemies in the mission is automatically scaled based on level.
 
 [Friendship Achievements] have been added.
  - As you build friendships with allies, you can complete friendship achievements.
  - Complete various achievements with each ally and obtain various rewards.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Addition of Sales Tax
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953157/e468853698b2a70b9342b73b4a37a7db7fd8a438.jpg

Greetings Mercenaries,

We are legally required as a company to collect sales tax on monetary purchases from some states or provinces in the United States and Canada. Therefore, starting October 1st, 2019, we will begin collecting sales tax on NX purchased on the NEXON website for those locations. This will only affect players purchasing NX from within the United States and Canada.

When you purchase NX from the NEXON website, your country will either be automatically determined, or you will be prompted to select a country. If your location is in the United States or Canada, you will also need to provide your zip code for tax calculation purposes. The sales tax will then be adjusted based on your location and added to the total purchase amount. You will be able to review the final price before making the actual purchase.

When redeeming a Karma Koin card on the website, the sales tax will be calculated and the amount of NX you receive from the card will be adjusted to account for it. Once your purchase is complete, you’ll receive an email confirmation that clearly shows the amount of tax paid.

Sales tax is only calculated when purchasing NX. Using NX for in-game item purchases does not incur sales tax. If you are buying an in-game item using NX and have insufficient funds, you have the option to purchase additional NX. NX purchased at this time would be eligible for sales tax.

We hope for your kind understanding regarding in advance.

- The Vindictus Team

notes.title: [Events] Grave of Madness Update & Events!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/19f5d21c09d0a444fa8405a4f751f062ff489e2b.jpg

New Raid Boss: Agares
Be prepared to face the notoriously barbaric and destructive raid boss, Agares!

Agares is a skilled hunter who can shatter a huge stone pillar into pieces with a single blow and uses physical strength to close in on its preys. The deep caves where you fight is Agares' hunting grounds, where you will face Agares, who wields the giant hammer. And will crush you into pieces.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/b92ead09a691a04d7dffb65b2a62ce0e81b15de5.jpg

In the midst of battles, Agares temporarily puts his hammer down and boasts its strength by wielding and swinging a giant pillar that looks almost impossible to even lift. Pillar attacks are slow, but their attack range is wide. Even a small move creates a shockwave and if you fail to dodge and are hit, you may take a large amount of damage. So, make sure to always be on your guard mercenaries.

Sounds a bit intimidating? Fear not mercenaries, to support your victories, we have prepared events for you, so check them out below!

CLICKfor more details to the update and the event!

notes.title: [Update] v.2.48 Updates
notes.content:
1. Guild House

Guild Fund
Added 'Guild Fund' to the 'Guild' window.
  - The 'Guild Fund' is a shared pool of funds that is bound to the guild.
  - Use the 'Donate to Guild Fund' button to donate Gold to the guild.
  - Use the 'Guild Member' tab to view guild member donation history.
  - Costs related to guild house activities such as 'buying a house,' 'house dues,' etc, are deducted from the 'Guild Fund.'
  - Gold is permanently bound to the guild once donated and cannot be taken back.

Guild House
Added 'Guild House' tab to the 'Guild' window.
  - Use the 'Guild House' tab to buy houses and check statuses.
  - The Guild Master/Administrator can use the 'Manage' tab - and then 'Manage Guild House' to demolish or upgrade houses.
  - If you own a Guild House, dues (10,000,000 Gold) are paid automatically every 30 days. If paid continuously without missing a payment, a discount of up to 20% is applied.
Added new 'Guild House' map.
  - Use the 'Guild House' tab to enter/exit.
Added new environmental interaction movements.
  - New interactive poses such as lying down, tube riding, drinking cocktails, etc, can be used according to the environment.

Unseal Furniture
'Resenlian's Doll,' 'Vending Machine,' 'Mirror Ball,' 'Jukebox' = Furniture with special functions must be unsealed in order to use them.
  - The Guild Master/Administrator can start unsealing by paying Guild Funds.
  - The Unseal Gauge will fill up as time passes, and guild members can tap the [Support] button to shorten the time it takes to unseal.
  - Once the Unseal Gauge is at 100%, the Guild Master/Administrator can complete the unsealing.

Click v.2.48 Updatesfor more details!

notes.title: [Events] The Red Stigma Conqueror Event
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/5475344182c4ef5c9dd5bdb7192c43e08006f8c8.jpg

2019-01-21 Update:

For a little over a month, we've asked and looked for honorable heroes who've taken on against the unpredictable goddess, Macha, who drives her powers from chaos, pain, and fury. The heroes who have successfully taken on this conquest and have submitted moments of their noble victories against the great Macha have been listed below. Please join us in congratulating and recognizing the achievements of their completion!

CLICK HERE TO SEE THE WINNERS LIST!
Thank you for your participation in this event.



Macha, the unpredictable goddess, is infamous for deriving her power from chaos, pain, and fury. And if you recall all the chaos in the past, not even gods could control her. Then something happened, which led to her being stripped of her divine status and most of her powers. After that, she left the divine realm and never returned.

Mercenaries, now you will have the chance to face the Goddess that was once thrown out of Paradise. She is one brutal goddess, and today, you have the chance to defeat this ungraceful being. Never underestimate Macha, and beware as she can still find weak points in your heart and mind.

Display your honorable victory against Macha on the Vindictus Forum: CLICK HERE!

And the first 10 Heroes that posted the screenshot of their completion of the Red Stigma battle and their victory against Macha will get Red Stigma Event Reward on the 22nd of January! And the rest of you that have completed will also be receiving rewards listed below.

CLICK HERE to find out more details to the event!

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Destruction Safeguard Rune
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenaries,

As mentioned on yesterday's 'Weekly Maintenance: October 30th' post on our official Vindictus website, the 'Destruction Safeguard Rune' will be removed from the Shop and will no longer be available for purchase after today's maintenance due to enhancement revamps and legal issues.

To give a proper farewell to a Rune we dearly loved, we've organized a small event for you as below:

Note:

 Items that were previously purchased may be used normally in-game regardless of the sales end date.
 In addition to the Cash Shop, the sale of the 'Destruction Safeguard Rune' will also be removed from the 'Seal of Bravery Shop' and the 'Monthly Mission Ticket Exchange Shop.'
 

Event: Farewell Destruction Safeguard Rune

 Starting Date: October 30th (After Maintenance)
 Ending Date: November 6th (Before Maintenance)


Event Details:

 Enhancement level decrease is prevented when attempting to enhance +10 to +14 items during the event period.

 
Event Target Items:

 Gear Protection Rune (+10 to +12)
 Destruction Safeguard Rune
 Destruction Safeguard Rune (Gift)
 Destruction Safeguard Rune (Gift, Binding)
 Unstable Destruction Safeguard Rune (Binding)

 
Note:

 This event applies to all 'Event Target Items,' regardless of how the item was acquired.
 When attempting to use the 'Event Target Items' after the event period, the enhancement level decrease will be applied as it was before.
 As this event only applies to minimum +10 / maximum +14 items, items +15 or higher will not be applied when attempting to enhance.
 
When Using the 'Destruction Safeguard Rune:'

 As enhancement systems have been revamped, enhancement failures of the 'Destruction Safeguard Rune' after the event period will be applied as below:
  - When failure to enhance using the 'Destruction Safeguard Rune,' enhancement level decrease will be applied as before and the percentage of the enhancement bonus will be applied at the decreased enhancement level rate.
 

Once again, thank you for understanding and continuous support.

- The Vindictus Team -

notes.title: [Notice] Upcoming Redeemers Integration
notes.content:
Greetings Mercenaries,

The Redeemers Battle that is able to depart with the Guild Departure Licenses and or Departure Licenses (maximum twice per week), will be integrated together as one with this upcoming September 4th’s update.

The Redeemers Battle is right now limited to a maximum of two battle completions per week, and two extra battles through Guild Departures or Departure Licenses.

Since the current Redeemers Battle system, which is divided into several sections such as Redeemers/Guild and Redeemers/Departure Licenses, is largely viewed as an inconvenience, we have decided to combine these to provide the most convenient way of participating in Redeemers Battles.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/7a3aa897771ba96d7cf6427eabf63ffce950feb4.jpg

With this integration as shown above, the ‘[Guild] Sea of Reflection/Dark Side of the Moon Battle’ and the ‘[Passport] Sea of Reflection/Dark Side of the Moon’ will be removed and no longer require any extra Guild or Departure Licenses.

Players who have Departure Licenses will be able to sell them in-game at an adjusted price after the weekly maintenance on September 4th, Tuesday.

We hope this will bring more convenience and pleasure to your Vindictus experience.

- The Vindictus Team

notes.title: Matryoshba Event & More!
notes.content:
Matryoshba Event
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/c897e516c29bb05f1c5d1a202b5cae53a2ecfe22.png
Start: July 10th (End of Maintenance) / End: July 31st (Start of Maintenance)

As you may have sensed this already, the Strange Traveler is quite a peculiar being. And rumor has it that he has started collecting something. Let’s see what he’s up to shall we. 
Once you go and talk to the Strange Traveler during the event period, he’ll tell you about his new hobby, collecting Matryoshbas, and he’ll ask you for your help. 
First, let us tell you a little bit about Matryoshbas. There are four different Matryoshbas: Baby Matryoshba, Kid Matryoshba, Young Matryoshba, and Matryoshba. And here’s a chart that simplifies how you can obtain each Matryoshbas:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/0e49b39fac4994d52df3c9175cb85515ab1eabe6.jpg

Exchange Shop Items (Available During 7/10-8/7):
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/5dd2afeb9f34d2783387acf32b0d38f44e38b28a.jpg
* Please note that ALL Matryoshbas and the items purchased from the Exchange Shop are restricted from being used in the Marketplace, via Mail/Account Mail, Guild Box, and Shared Storage. However, Shiba Chapeau can be transferred within your account to other characters and is also tradeable.


The Traveler's Cool Gift Event
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3953157/a078c5a536fba1e4cfb8c76f660c6f2dfd1a32d2.png
Start: July 10th (End of Maintenance) / End: July 31st (Start of Maintenance)

Join us and cool off with the Traveler’s Cool Gift Event. Go talk to the Strange Traveler and get your first 10 water balloons per day for free! And, don’t’ worry if you run out of your 10 water balloons. You can purchase 10 additional water balloons for 1,000 Gold. 

You can use these water balloons as your support weapon against the monsters in all battles excluding Raids. Once you smash the water balloons onto the monsters effectively, they’ll freeze up and will be slowed down. If you succeed in total water bombing annihilation and manage to destroy the monsters using the water balloons, you will have the chance to receive these titles:
'Slick as Summer Ice: Used 10 Water Balloons'
'Summer Hydromaniac: Used 100 Water Balloons'
And once you’ve received the ‘Summer Flu’ title, go to the Strange Traveler and receive the cool Marine T-shirt as your reward! (Image only available for the male version) Also, the Marine T-shirt is a regular equipment and therefore you can customize it by dying it!

These water balloons are full of cold liquid and they can even freeze boss monsters. Equip these water balloons in your secondary weapon slot and get ready to freeze your foes up!
